questions.stem: Which sentence means "Tell me your birthday."?
questions.explanation: {告诉|gào su} + person + thing: {告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}. {说|shuō} can't take the person as an object. With {我|wǒ} first, the last sentence says "I'll tell your birthday", and the person can't come at the end.

questions.stem: Which is the usual birthday greeting?
questions.explanation: Wishes use {快乐|kuài lè}, after the occasion: {生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}！ (and {新年|xīn nián}{快乐|kuài lè}！). {高兴|gāo xìng} is "glad" about something now, not used in wishes; English order "happy birthday" gives the wrong {快乐|kuài lè}{生日|shēng rì}; and {很|hěn} turns the wish into a statement.

questions.stem: In "{我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{过年|guò nián}。", what does 过 mean?
questions.explanation: Here {过|guò} (fourth tone) is the main verb: {过年|guò nián} is to celebrate, to spend the New Year: "We're spending New Year in Beijing." The experience particle {过|guo} (lesson 10) is light and comes after another verb: {去|qù}{过|guo}.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{明年|míng nián}{去|qù}{中国|Zhōng guó}。" mean?
choices: I'm planning to go to China next year.
I went to China last year.
I'm getting things ready for my trip to China today.
questions.explanation: {准备|zhǔn bèi} + a verb is "plan to, be going to". {明年|míng nián} is next year ({去年|qù nián} would be last year), and "have been" would need {过|guo}: {去|qù}{过|guo}.

questions.stem: Your friend says "{我们|wǒ men}{给|gěi}{她|tā}{过|guò}{生日|shēng rì}{吧|ba}！" You agree warmly:
questions.explanation: {好|hǎo}{啊|a}！ is "Great! Sure!": {啊|a} adds warmth. {好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？ asks back "OK?", {呢|ne} doesn't go here, and {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si} is "sorry" (lesson 15).

questions.stem: Which pinyin is right for 告诉 (to tell)?
questions.explanation: 告诉 is gào su: a falling tone, then a light, short su. 诉 has its full tone, sù, only in other words.

questions.stem: Which pinyin is right for 准备 (to prepare)?
questions.explanation: 准备 is zhǔn bèi: zh with the tongue curled back, a low third tone, then a fall. z (flat tongue) is a different initial.

questions.stem: Which character completes {生日|shēng rì}{快|kuài} ___ (shēng rì kuài lè, happy birthday)?
questions.explanation: {=Happy is {快乐|kuài lè}, with 乐: a short left-falling stroke, a vertical that turns right, the long vertical hook and two dots. 东 (east) has a horizontal on top, 牛 (ox) and 午 (noon) have a vertical straight through.=} (Simplified forms: in traditional script the word is {+{快乐|kuài lè}+}.)

questions.stem: Which character has the new radical 夂 (a foot), on top?
questions.explanation: {=备 (prepare) is 夂 over 田. 送 has 辶 (movement), 告 has 口 at the bottom, and 快 has 忄 (heart) on the left.=} (Simplified forms: traditional {+备+} has 亻 on the left and no 夂.)

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: 告 (in {告诉|gào su}) tells, 送 gives as a present, 花 has 艹 for plants, and 乐 is the happy in {快乐|kuài lè}. "Prepare" is {准备|zhǔn bèi}.

questions.stem: Listen. When is the speaker's birthday?
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}{是|shì}{五|wǔ}{月|yuè}{十|shí}{号|hào}: the tenth of May. Chinese dates go big to small, month ({五|wǔ}{月|yuè}) before day ({十|shí}{号|hào}).

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{送|sòng}{妈妈|mā ma}{花|huā}: giver, {送|sòng}, the person who receives, then the present. "Mum gives me" would start with {妈妈|mā ma}.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The question was {你们|nǐ men}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}{过年|guò nián}？ (Where are you spending the New Year?), so the answer is a place: {在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng} (in Beijing). A date answers "when", and {去|qù}{过|guo} answers "have you been?".

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
choices: He told me where he was going.
I didn't tell him where I was going.
He didn't tell me where he was going.
He didn't ask me where I was going.
questions.explanation: You heard {他|tā}{没|méi}{告诉|gào su}{我|wǒ}{他|tā}{去|qù}{哪儿|nǎr}: "He didn't tell me where he was going." The person told ({我|wǒ}) follows {告诉|gào su}, then comes the thing told, here a whole clause. Asking would be {问|wèn}.

questions.stem: Read the message ({不用|bú yòng}: no need to): "{这|zhè}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{三|sān}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{五|wǔ}{楼|lóu}。{不用|bú yòng}{送|sòng}{我|wǒ}{东西|dōng xi}！{艾米|Ài mǐ}" What does Amy say about presents?
choices: There's no need to give her anything.
questions.explanation: {不用|bú yòng}{送|sòng}{我|wǒ}{东西|dōng xi}: "no need to give me anything". {送|sòng} is giving a present, {东西|dōng xi} "things".

questions.stem: Read the same message again: "{这|zhè}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{是|shì}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}，{请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{来|lái}{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}。{我|wǒ}{家|jiā}{在|zài}{三|sān}{号|hào}{楼|lóu}{五|wǔ}{楼|lóu}。" When and where is the party?
choices: Saturday at six in the morning, on the third floor
Saturday at six in the evening, building 3, fifth floor
questions.explanation: {星期|xīng qī}{六|liù} is Saturday and {晚上|wǎn shang}{六|liù}{点|diǎn} six in the evening. The address goes big to small: {三|sān}{号|hào}{楼|lóu} (building number 3), then {五|wǔ}{楼|lóu} (the fifth floor).

questions.stem: Read: "{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{明天|míng tiān}{是|shì}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}，{我们|wǒ men}{给|gěi}{她|tā}{过|guò}{生日|shēng rì}{吧|ba}。{爸爸|bà ba}：{好|hǎo}{啊|a}！{我|wǒ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{晚饭|wǎn fàn}，{你|nǐ}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{花|huā}。" What will Wang Fang do?
questions.explanation: Dad says {你|nǐ}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{花|huā}: "you go and buy flowers". He will make dinner himself ({我|wǒ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{晚饭|wǎn fàn}). The birthday is Grandma's ({奶奶|nǎi nai}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Mum is giving me a watch.
questions.explanation: Giver, {送|sòng}, the person, then the thing: {妈妈|mā ma}{送|sòng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{块|kuài}{手表|shǒu biǎo} ({块|kuài} is the measure word for a watch). {说|shuō} (say) can't take a person and a thing like this.

questions.stem: Write the greeting "Happy birthday!" for a card, in Chinese characters (pinyin with tones is accepted too): ___
accept: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
zhù nín shēng rì kuài lè
questions.explanation: {生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}！ The occasion comes first, then {快乐|kuài lè}. On a card you can add {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ} in front: {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}！

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {生日|shēng rì}, birthday: high and level, then a fall (1 + 4).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {送|sòng}, to give as a present: the fourth tone, falling.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? (My brother is taller than me.)
questions.explanation: A {比|bǐ} B + adjective, with nothing before the adjective: {哥哥|gē ge}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}. {很|hěn} and {非常|fēi cháng} can't go inside a {比|bǐ} sentence, and {比|bǐ} + B comes before the adjective, not after it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He's three years older than me."?
questions.explanation: The difference goes after the adjective: {大|dà}{三|sān}{岁|suì}. Ages are compared with {大|dà} (older) and {小|xiǎo} (younger). {很|hěn} never goes inside a {比|bǐ} sentence.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "What's your favourite colour?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{很|hěn}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{颜色|yán sè}？
{你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{最|zuì}{什么|shén me}{颜色|yán sè}？
{你|nǐ}{最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{颜色|yán sè}？
{你|nǐ}{最|zuì}{什么|shén me}{颜色|yán sè}{喜欢|xǐ huan}？
questions.explanation: "Favourite" is {最|zuì}{喜欢|xǐ huan}: {最|zuì} is an adverb and goes right before the verb. It takes no {很|hěn}, and the object still follows the verb.

questions.stem: A Chinese friend says: "{你|nǐ}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{很|hěn}{不错|bú cuò}！" What do they mean?
choices: Your Chinese has a few mistakes.
Your Chinese is OK, but not good.
questions.explanation: {不错|bú cuò} looks like "not wrong" but is real praise, "pretty good"; {很|hěn}{不错|bú cuò} is "really good". It isn't a polite way of saying "not good enough".

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{手机|shǒu jī}{坏|huài}{了|le}。" mean?
questions.explanation: {坏|huài} is "bad", and with change-of-state {了|le} "broken, not working any more". New would be {新|xīn}, slow {慢|màn}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm going to the supermarket with Mum."?
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn} + person goes before the verb, like {在|zài} + place: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{妈妈|mā ma}{去|qù}{超市|chāo shì}. "With Mum" at the end is English word order.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 最 (most)?
questions.explanation: 最 is zuì, falling, spelled ui and said "zuei". z is flat (like ds in "kids"), not the curled zh.

questions.stem: In 不错 (pretty good), how is 不 said?
questions.explanation: 不 becomes bú, rising, before a fourth tone, and 错 cuò is a fourth tone: bú cuò. Before other tones it stays bù ({不|bù}{好|hǎo}).

questions.stem: Which character means "than; to compare"?
questions.explanation: 比 is two similar halves side by side, both facing right. 北 (north) has its halves back to back, 此 (this) has 止 on the left, and 化 (change) has 亻 on the left.

questions.stem: Which radical do 慢 (slow) and 快 (fast) share?
questions.explanation: Both have 忄, the standing heart: two dots and a long vertical. 快 once meant "pleased", a feeling; 曼 gives 慢 its sound, màn.

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {快|kuài} and {慢|màn} are opposites (both with 忄), {错|cuò} is the opposite of {对|duì}, and {坏|huài} the opposite of {好|hǎo}. "Most" is {最|zuì}.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
questions.explanation: You heard {今天|jīn tiān}{比|bǐ}{昨天|zuó tiān}{冷|lěng}: A (today) is colder than B (yesterday). The thing that has more of the quality comes first.

questions.stem: Listen. Which is true?
choices: That one costs fifty yuan more.
This one costs fifty yuan more.
questions.explanation: You heard {这个|zhè ge}{比|bǐ}{那个|nà ge}{贵|guì}{五十|wǔ shí}{块|kuài}: this one is fifty yuan more expensive than that one. The amount after {贵|guì} is the difference, not the price.

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
choices: I'm the tallest in our family.
questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{家|jiā}{我|wǒ}{最|zuì}{高|gāo}: "(In) our family, I'm the tallest". The group comes first as a topic, then {最|zuì} + adjective.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want you to do?
questions.explanation: You heard {请|qǐng}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō}: "Please speak a bit more slowly." Hurry up would be {快|kuài}{点儿|diǎnr}.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà}{两|liǎng}{岁|suì}，{也|yě}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}。{我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{最|zuì}{小|xiǎo}，{她|tā}{说话|shuō huà}{最|zuì}{快|kuài}。" Who is the youngest?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{最|zuì}{小|xiǎo}: the younger sister is the youngest. The brother is two years older than the writer ({比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà}{两|liǎng}{岁|suì}).

questions.stem: Read: "{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{比|bǐ}{坐|zuò}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{快|kuài}。{打车|dǎ chē}{比|bǐ}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{快|kuài}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}，{也|yě}{最|zuì}{贵|guì}。{走路|zǒu lù}{最|zuì}{慢|màn}。" Which is the fastest?
questions.explanation: The metro is faster than the bus, and a taxi a little faster than the metro, so a taxi is the fastest (and the most expensive, {最|zuì}{贵|guì}). Walking is the slowest ({最|zuì}{慢|màn}).

questions.stem: Read: "A：{这|zhè}{两|liǎng}{件|jiàn}{衣服|yī fu}，{哪|nǎ}{件|jiàn}{好看|hǎo kàn}？ B：{红|hóng}{的|de}{比|bǐ}{白|bái}{的|de}{好看|hǎo kàn}。{白|bái}{的|de}{比|bǐ}{红|hóng}{的|de}{便宜|pián yi}{一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}。{我|wǒ}{买|mǎi}{白|bái}{的|de}{吧|ba}。" Why does B buy the white one?
questions.explanation: The red one looks better ({红|hóng}{的|de}{比|bǐ}{白|bái}{的|de}{好看|hǎo kàn}), but the white one is a hundred yuan cheaper ({便宜|pián yi}{一百|yì bǎi}{块|kuài}), and B takes it. {红|hóng}{的|de} and {白|bái}{的|de} stand for "the red one" and "the white one".

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: This one is a little more expensive than that one.
questions.explanation: A {比|bǐ} B + adjective + {一点儿|yì diǎnr}: {这个|zhè ge}{比|bǐ}{那个|nà ge}{贵|guì}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}. "A little" follows the adjective, and {很|hěn} has no place in a {比|bǐ} sentence.

questions.stem: Fill in the number in characters (or pinyin with tones): {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{大|dà} ___ {岁|suì}。 (He's two years older than me.)
questions.explanation: Before a measure word, two is {两|liǎng}: {大|dà}{两|liǎng}{岁|suì}. {二|èr} is for counting and in numbers like {十二|shí èr}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {慢|màn}, slow: the fourth tone, falling.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {跟|gēn}, with; to follow: the first tone, high and level.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Although I'm tired, I'm happy."?
choices: {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{我|wǒ}{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
{很|hěn}{累|lèi}{虽然|suī rán}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
{虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{虽然|suī rán}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}。
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán} opens the first half and {但是|dàn shì} the second, before its subject: {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{我|wǒ}{很|hěn}{高兴|gāo xìng}. {但是|dàn shì} never follows the subject, {虽然|suī rán} doesn't go at the end, and the two can't swap places.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Why are you learning Chinese?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{为什么|wèi shén me}？
{你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}？
{为什么|wèi shén me}{学|xué}{你|nǐ}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}？
{你|nǐ}{学|xué}{为什么|wèi shén me}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}？
questions.explanation: {为什么|wèi shén me} goes after the subject and before the verb: {你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}？ (It may also open the sentence.) It never goes at the end like an English afterthought, and it can't split the verb from its object.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This film is boring."?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{不|bù}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{很|hěn}{意思|yì si}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{有|yǒu}{不|bú}{意思|yì si}。
{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{没意思|méi yì si}。
questions.explanation: Boring is {没意思|méi yì si}: {有|yǒu} is negated with {没|méi}, never {不|bù}. {意思|yì si} alone is "meaning", so {很|hěn}{意思|yì si} doesn't say anything.

questions.stem: You arrive five minutes late to meet a friend. What is the most natural thing to say?
choices: {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}，{我|wǒ}{来|lái}{晚|wǎn}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: For a small thing like being a little late, the light apology {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si} fits. {对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{错|cuò}{了|le} is a heavy apology for a real wrong; {没关系|méi guān xi} is what your friend answers; {不客气|bú kè qi} answers thanks.

questions.stem: A: "{你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{没|méi}{去|qù}{上课|shàng kè}？" B: ___
questions.explanation: A {为什么|wèi shén me} question is answered with {因为|yīn wèi} (because): "Because I was ill." {所以|suǒ yǐ} introduces a result, {虽然|suī rán} and {但是|dàn shì} a contrast.

questions.stem: How do you ask "What does this character mean?"
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{有意思|yǒu yì si}{吗|ma}？
{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{为什么|wèi shén me}？
{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{意思|yì si}？
{这个|zhè ge}{字|zì}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？
questions.explanation: …{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{意思|yì si}？ asks for the meaning. {有意思|yǒu yì si}{吗|ma}？ asks "is it interesting?", and {怎么样|zěn me yàng} "what do you think of it?".

questions.stem: Which pinyin is right for 虽然 (although)?
questions.explanation: 虽然 is suī rán: high and level, then rising. s is flat (not the curled sh), and the r is the curled-back r of 日 rì.

questions.stem: In 不好意思, how is 不 said?
questions.explanation: 不 changes to bú only before a fourth tone. Here it comes before 好 hǎo, a third tone, so it keeps its fourth tone: bù hǎo yì si.

questions.stem: Which character completes {意|yì} ___ (yì si, meaning)?
questions.explanation: Meaning is {意思|yì si}: 思 is 田 over 心. 恩 (kindness) has 因 over 心, 息 (in {休息|xiū xi}) has 自 over 心, and 想 (to think, would like) has 相 over 心: all four share the heart at the bottom.

questions.stem: Which two characters share the radical 心 (heart) at the bottom?
questions.explanation: 意 and 思 both end in 心: the left dot, the long curved stroke with a hook, then two dots. 但 has 亻 on the left, {=虽 has 虫 at the bottom=}, and 然 has the four dots of 灬 (fire).

questions.stem: Match each word to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán}…{但是|dàn shì} link a contrast, {为什么|wèi shén me} asks why, and {有意思|yǒu yì si} is interesting. "Because" is {因为|yīn wèi} (lesson 05).

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
choices: It isn't expensive, and it isn't beautiful.
questions.explanation: You heard {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{贵|guì}，{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}: although it's expensive, it's beautiful. "So" would be {所以|suǒ yǐ}, and cheap {便宜|pián yi}.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{不|bú}{去|qù}？ (Why aren't you going?), so the answer gives a reason with {因为|yīn wèi}: "Because I'm busy." The others don't answer "why".

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker say?
choices: This book is a bit expensive.
questions.explanation: You heard {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}: this book is really interesting. Boring would be {没意思|méi yì si}; asking for a meaning, {是|shì}{什么|shén me}{意思|yì si}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker doing?

audio.text: 不好意思，请问地铁站在哪儿？

questions.explanation: You heard {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}，{请问|qǐng wèn}{地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？: "Excuse me, where's the metro station?" {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si} is the polite way to stop someone before asking.

questions.stem: Read the message: "{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}：{不好意思|bù hǎo yì si}，{今天|jīn tiān}{我|wǒ}{不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{上课|shàng kè}{了|le}。{因为|yīn wèi}{我|wǒ}{生病|shēng bìng}{了|le}，{医生|yī shēng}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。{大卫|Dà wèi}" Why can't David go to class?
questions.explanation: {因为|yīn wèi}{我|wǒ}{生病|shēng bìng}{了|le}: because he has fallen ill. The doctor ({医生|yī shēng}) told him to rest.

questions.stem: Read the same message: "{因为|yīn wèi}{我|wǒ}{生病|shēng bìng}{了|le}，{医生|yī shēng}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{要|yào}{在|zài}{家|jiā}{休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}。" How long does he have to rest?
questions.explanation: {休息|xiū xi}{两|liǎng}{天|tiān}: rest for two days. The duration comes after the verb, as you learned in HSK 1. Two hours would be {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}.

questions.stem: Read: "A：{你|nǐ}{觉得|jué de}{这个|zhè ge}{电影|diàn yǐng}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ B：{虽然|suī rán}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{长|cháng}，{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}。" What does B think of the film?
choices: It's a bit long, but interesting.
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán}{有点儿|yǒu diǎnr}{长|cháng}，{但是|dàn shì}{很|hěn}{有意思|yǒu yì si}: although it's a bit long, it's interesting. {长|cháng} is long; boring would be {没意思|méi yì si}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'd like to go, but I haven't got time.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}，{但是|dàn shì}{没有|méi yǒu}{时间|shí jiān}: {但是|dàn shì} starts the second half. {所以|suǒ yǐ} (so) would give a result, not a contrast.

questions.stem: Type the Chinese for "why", in characters or in pinyin with tones: ___
questions.explanation: {为什么|wèi shén me} (type wei4shen2me for the pinyin): "for what". It goes after the subject: {你|nǐ}{为什么|wèi shén me}{不|bú}{去|qù}？

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the three syllables?
questions.explanation: {为什么|wèi shén me}, why: a fall, a rise and a light neutral syllable (4 + 2 + neutral).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {但是|dàn shì}, but: two falling tones (4 + 4).

questions.stem: When is the Spring Festival ({春节|Chūn jié})?
choices: the first day of the first lunar month
the fifteenth day of the first lunar month
the shortest day of the year
questions.explanation: {春节|Chūn jié} is {正月|zhēng yuè}{初一|chū yī}, the first day of the lunar year. The fifteenth is the Lantern Festival ({元宵节|Yuán xiāo jié}), which ends the season. 1 January is New Year in the ordinary calendar, also a holiday but a much smaller one.

questions.stem: In the ordinary (Gregorian) calendar, when does the Spring Festival fall?
questions.explanation: It follows the moon, so it moves: it is always on a new moon between 21 January and 20 February.

questions.stem: Why do many people hang the character {福|fú} (good fortune) upside down?
choices: to keep bad luck out of the house
because it is easier to read from the street
because "upside down", {倒|dào}, sounds like "to arrive", {到|dào}
because the New Year turns the old year upside down
questions.explanation: Seeing it, people say {福|fú}{倒|dào}{了|le} (the fortune is upside down), which sounds the same as {福|fú}{到|dào}{了|le} (good fortune has arrived). It's a pun, like many New Year customs.

questions.stem: Why is fish ({鱼|yú}) served at the reunion dinner?
choices: because fish is the cheapest dish
because the festival starts by a river
because {鱼|yú} sounds like {余|yú} (surplus), as in {年年有余|nián nián yǒu yú}
questions.explanation: {年年有余|nián nián yǒu yú} wishes "plenty left over every year", and {余|yú} sounds like {鱼|yú}. That's also why some fish is often left uneaten on purpose.

questions.stem: Who usually gives a {红包|hóng bāo} (red envelope) to whom?
choices: older, married relatives to children and younger unmarried relatives
guests to the host of the dinner
questions.explanation: Red envelopes with money go from older, married relatives to children and to younger relatives who aren't married; some employers give them too. Today many are sent by phone.

questions.stem: Many families watch the Spring Festival Gala ({春晚|Chūn wǎn}) on New Year's Eve. Since when has it been broadcast?
questions.explanation: The gala, with songs, dances, comedy sketches ({小品|xiǎo pǐn}) and comic dialogues ({相声|xiàng sheng}), has been on television every New Year's Eve since 1983.

questions.stem: What is {春运|chūn yùn}?
choices: the first meal of the new year
the travel rush of about forty days around the Spring Festival
the spring cleaning before the New Year
questions.explanation: {春运|chūn yùn}, the "Spring Festival transport" season, is the wave of travel as people go home for the reunion and come back: about forty days, often called the largest yearly migration in the world. The cleaning is {大扫除|dà sǎo chú}.

questions.stem: Listen. When would you say this?
choices: when you thank someone for a present
when you meet people during the New Year holiday
questions.explanation: You heard {过年好|guò nián hǎo}！, "Happy New Year!", the spoken greeting during the Spring Festival. At a birthday you say {生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}.

questions.stem: Listen. What are they going to do?
choices: go home for the New Year's Eve dinner
go out to a restaurant for lunch
questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{回家|huí jiā}{吃|chī}{年夜饭|nián yè fàn}: "We're going home for the New Year's Eve dinner", the reunion meal.

questions.stem: Read: "{除夕|chú xī}{晚上|wǎn shang}，{我们|wǒ men}{一|yì}{家|jiā}{人|rén}{在|zài}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{家|jiā}{吃|chī}{年夜饭|nián yè fàn}。{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{看|kàn}{春晚|Chūn wǎn}。" ({以后|yǐ hòu}: after.) What does everyone do after dinner?
choices: watch the New Year's gala on TV
questions.explanation: {吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{以后|yǐ hòu}，{大家|dà jiā}{看|kàn}{春晚|Chūn wǎn}: after the meal they all watch the Spring Festival Gala.

questions.stem: Read: "{奶奶|nǎi nai}{送|sòng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{红包|hóng bāo}，{我|wǒ}{说|shuō}：“{谢谢|xiè xie}{奶奶|nǎi nai}，{新年|xīn nián}{快乐|kuài lè}！”" What did the writer get?
questions.explanation: {红包|hóng bāo} is a red envelope with money inside. {送|sòng} + person + thing: Grandma gave me a red envelope.

questions.stem: Which festival traditionally ends the New Year season, on the fifteenth day?
choices: the Lantern Festival ({元宵节|Yuán xiāo jié})
questions.explanation: The Lantern Festival, {元宵节|Yuán xiāo jié}, on the fifteenth day of the first lunar month (a full moon), closes the New Year season.

questions.stem: Why are long-life noodles ({长寿面|cháng shòu miàn}) eaten on birthdays?
choices: Long noodles stand for a long life.
Noodles are always eaten on the fifteenth of the month.
The word for noodles sounds like "birthday".
questions.explanation: The idea is simple: long noodles, long life ({长寿|cháng shòu}). That's why they are kept long.

questions.stem: What do people try not to do with long-life noodles?
questions.explanation: Cutting the noodles would "shorten" the long life they stand for, so people keep them as long as they can.

questions.stem: What is a {寿桃|shòu táo}?
choices: a bowl of noodles with peaches
a steamed bun shaped like a peach, for an older person's birthday
a peach tree planted for a baby
questions.explanation: {寿桃|shòu táo}, a "longevity peach", is a soft white steamed bun with a pink tip and a sweet filling. The peach has long stood for long life.

questions.stem: When does a family hold {抓周|zhuā zhōu}?
choices: on a child's first day at school
questions.explanation: {抓周|zhuā zhōu} is a first-birthday custom: objects are put in front of the child, and the one picked first is said to show the child's future.

questions.stem: At {抓周|zhuā zhōu}, a child picks up a book. What future does that traditionally stand for?
questions.explanation: A book stands for a scholar. A stethoscope would be a doctor, an abacus or calculator business, and money wealth. Few parents take it as a real prediction today.

questions.stem: Some families add celery ({芹菜|qín cài}) to the objects. Why?
choices: Celery is the child's first vegetable.
Celery is green, the colour of luck.
It stands for a future cook.
questions.explanation: It's a sound pun: {芹|qín} (celery) sounds like {勤|qín} (hard-working). Spring onion ({葱|cōng}) works the same way with {聪|cōng}, as in {聪明|cōng ming} (clever).

questions.stem: How is nominal age ({虚岁|xū suì}) counted?
choices: zero at birth, one more on each birthday
one at birth, one more on each birthday
one at birth, one more at each lunar New Year
questions.explanation: In the traditional count a child is one at birth and gets a year older at every lunar New Year, not on the birthday. The modern count from birthdays is {周岁|zhōu suì}.

questions.stem: Which age is used officially in mainland China (on documents, at school)?
choices: the age by the lunar calendar
{周岁|zhōu suì}, the actual age from birthdays
questions.explanation: Only {周岁|zhōu suì} is used officially. Some older people and some families still give {虚岁|xū suì}, which can be up to two years more.

questions.stem: Listen. Who is this most likely said to?
choices: someone older, such as a grandparent or a teacher
a close friend of the same age
questions.explanation: You heard {祝|zhù}{您|nín}{生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}！ The polite {您|nín} shows respect, so it suits someone older. To a friend or a child you'd say {你|nǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker suggest?
questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{吃|chī}{长寿面|cháng shòu miàn}{吧|ba}: "Let's have long-life noodles." {吧|ba} makes it a suggestion.

questions.stem: Read: "{今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{爷爷|yé ye}{的|de}{生日|shēng rì}，{他|tā}{七十|qī shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}。{妈妈|mā ma}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{了|le}{长寿面|cháng shòu miàn}，{我|wǒ}{送|sòng}{了|le}{爷爷|yé ye}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}。" What did the writer give Grandpa?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{送|sòng}{了|le}{爷爷|yé ye}{一|yì}{本|běn}{书|shū}: I gave Grandpa a book. Mum made the noodles.

questions.stem: Read ({放|fàng}: to put; {笔|bǐ}: pen): "{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{今天|jīn tiān}{一|yí}{岁|suì}。{爸爸|bà ba}{妈妈|mā ma}{在|zài}{桌子|zhuō zi}{上|shàng}{放|fàng}{了|le}{书|shū}、{笔|bǐ}{和|hé}{钱|qián}。{小明|Xiǎo Míng}{拿|ná}{起来|qǐ lái}{的|de}{是|shì}{钱|qián}！" What does his pick traditionally stand for?
questions.explanation: He picked up the money ({拿|ná}{起来|qǐ lái}{的|de}{是|shì}{钱|qián}), which stands for wealth. The book would be a scholar, the pen ({笔|bǐ}) a writer.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Teacher Wang teaches us Chinese."?
choices: {王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{我们|wǒ men}。
{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{学|xué}{我们|wǒ men}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{我们|wǒ men}{教|jiāo}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
questions.explanation: {教|jiāo} takes two objects, the person first and the subject second: {教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}. "Teach Chinese to us" order is wrong in Chinese, {学|xué} is the learner's verb, and the objects follow the verb.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 教室 (classroom)?
questions.explanation: 教室 is jiào shì: in "classroom" 教 has the fourth tone. The verb "to teach" is {教|jiāo}, first tone, as in {老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我们|wǒ men} ___ {有|yǒu}{三十|sān shí}{个|gè}{学生|xué sheng}。 (There are thirty students in our class.)
questions.explanation: A class as a group of students is {班|bān}: {我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}. {课|kè} is a lesson ({汉语|Hàn yǔ}{课|kè}), and {上课|shàng kè} is to have class. {我们|wǒ men}{教室|jiào shì} would need {的|de} and would mean the room.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Our school starts (the term) on 1 September."?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{开学|kāi xué}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}。
{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}{我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}。
{我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}。
questions.explanation: The date goes before the verb, and {开学|kāi xué} takes no object: {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}. A time at the end copies English, {开学|kāi xué} can't have {学校|xué xiào} after it, and {开|kāi}{学校|xué xiào} would mean "open (run) a school".

questions.stem: What is a {书包|shū bāo}?
questions.explanation: {书包|shū bāo} is a "book bag", a school bag. A bookshop is {书店|shū diàn}, a notebook {本子|běn zi}, and a textbook {课本|kè běn} (HSK 3).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'm learning Chinese with Teacher Li."?
choices: {李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
questions.explanation: The learner says {跟|gēn} + teacher + {学|xué}: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}. {学|xué} can't take the teacher as an object; {李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{跟|gēn}{我|wǒ}{学|xué} means Teacher Li learns from me; and {我|wǒ}{教|jiāo}… means I teach Teacher Li.

questions.stem: Your friend says: "{我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{是|shì}{高中生|gāo zhōng shēng}。" Where does your friend's sister study?
questions.explanation: {高中|gāo zhōng} is senior high school, and {高中生|gāo zhōng shēng} a pupil there. A university student is a {大学生|dà xué shēng}, a primary school pupil a {小学生|xiǎo xué shēng}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {教|jiào} ___ (jiàoshì, classroom)?
questions.explanation: Classroom is 教室: 室 (room) is 宀 (roof) over 至. 至 alone lacks the roof; 空 (empty, HSK 3 words) has 穴 and 工; 宝 (treasure) has 玉 under the roof.

questions.stem: What is the radical on top of 笔 (pen), and what does it mean?
questions.explanation: {=笔 is ⺮ (bamboo) over 毛 (hair): a writing brush is hair in a bamboo handle. 艹 (grass) has one horizontal and two short verticals; ⺮ has two little three-stroke shapes side by side.=}

questions.stem: Which character has the radical 攵 ("tapping hand") on its right?
questions.explanation: 教 (teach) is 孝 on the left and 攵 on the right. 学 and 字 have 子 at the bottom; 考 (test, lesson 17) has 耂 on top, the same top as the left half of 教, but no 攵.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the classroom?
questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{教室|jiào shì}{在|zài}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}: our classroom is on the third floor. Number + {楼|lóu} is the floor, with no {第|dì}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does Teacher Li teach the speaker?
questions.explanation: You heard {李|Lǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}: Teacher Li teaches us to write characters. What is taught can be a verb phrase, here {写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{哪个|nǎ ge}{班|bān}？ (Which class are you in?). Answer with the class: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{二|èr}{班|bān}. The floor, the lesson and the room answer other questions.

questions.stem: Listen. What happens on 1 September?

audio.text: 我们学校九月一号开学。

questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}: our school starts on 1 September. {开学|kāi xué} is the start of the term.

questions.stem: Read: "{保罗|Bǎo luó}：{明天|míng tiān}{开学|kāi xué}！{我们|wǒ men}{班|bān}{的|de}{教室|jiào shì}{在|zài}{二|èr}{楼|lóu}。{何|Hé}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}，{孙|Sūn}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{数学|shù xué}。{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书包|shū bāo}{里|lǐ}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{本子|běn zi}{和|hé}{笔|bǐ}。{下午|xià wǔ}{下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我|wǒ}{留|liú}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}，{你|nǐ}{呢|ne}？——{赵雪|Zhào Xuě}" ({数学|shù xué}: maths; {以后|yǐ hòu}: after) Who teaches maths?
questions.explanation: {孙|Sūn}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}{数学|shù xué}: Teacher Sun teaches maths. Teacher He teaches Chinese; Zhao Xue wrote the message, and Paul is reading it.

questions.stem: Read the end of Zhao Xue's message to Paul: "…{你|nǐ}{的|de}{书包|shū bāo}{里|lǐ}{要|yào}{有|yǒu}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{本子|běn zi}{和|hé}{笔|bǐ}。{下午|xià wǔ}{下课|xià kè}{以后|yǐ hòu}{我|wǒ}{留|liú}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}，{你|nǐ}{呢|ne}？——{赵雪|Zhào Xuě}" What will Zhao Xue do after class?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{留|liú}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}: I'm staying at school. 留 liú is "to stay". The notebooks and pen are what Paul needs in his bag.

questions.stem: A sign on a door says: "{三|sān}{班|bān}{教室|jiào shì}　{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{学习|xué xí}" ({以后|yǐ hòu}: after) What does it tell students?
choices: Class 3's classroom is closed after four.
After four, students can study in Class 3's classroom.
questions.explanation: {三|sān}{班|bān}{教室|jiào shì} is Class 3's classroom, and {下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{以后|yǐ hòu}{请|qǐng}{在|zài}{这儿|zhèr}{学习|xué xí} invites students to study here after 4 p.m. {班|bān} is the class (the group), not a lesson that starts.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Who teaches you to write characters?
questions.explanation: Subject {谁|shéi}, then {教|jiāo}, the person and what is taught: {谁|shéi}{教|jiāo}{你们|nǐ men}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}？ The question word stays where the answer would go ({王|Wáng}{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{我们|wǒ men}…).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: My younger brother goes to senior high school in Beijing.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{弟弟|dì di}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{上|shàng}{高中|gāo zhōng}: the place with {在|zài} comes before the verb, and {上|shàng} + a school stage is "attend" ({教|jiāo}{高中|gāo zhōng} would mean teaching there). Family words need no {的|de}.

questions.stem: Write the answer in characters (pinyin with tone marks is accepted too). {你们|nǐ men}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}{上课|shàng kè}？ — {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài} ___ {上课|shàng kè}。 (in the classroom)
questions.explanation: The classroom is {教室|jiào shì}: 教 (here jiào) + 室 (room). {我们|wǒ men}{在|zài}{教室|jiào shì}{上课|shàng kè}: the place with {在|zài} before the verb.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {教室|jiào shì}, classroom: two falling fourth tones. In this word {教|jiào} is fourth tone; the verb "to teach" is {教|jiāo}, first tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {笔|bǐ}, pen: the third tone, low and dipping. {比|bǐ} (than) is the same syllable.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I didn't understand (what I heard)."?
questions.explanation: A result that didn't happen takes {没|méi} before the whole verb + complement, with no {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}. {不|bù} can't negate a result here, {了|le} doesn't go with {没|méi}, and nothing goes between {听|tīng} and {懂|dǒng}.

questions.stem: Choose the complement: {我|wǒ}{找|zhǎo} ___ {我|wǒ}{的|de}{笔|bǐ}{了|le}！ (I've found my pen!)
questions.explanation: {找|zhǎo} is "look for"; {找到|zhǎo dào} (look for + reach) is "find". {找完|zhǎo wán} would be "finish looking", {找错|zhǎo cuò} "look in the wrong place", and {懂|dǒng} goes with {听|tīng} and {看|kàn}.

questions.stem: Choose the complement: {这|zhè}{本|běn}{书|shū}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn} ___ {了|le}。 (I've read this book to the end.)
questions.explanation: {完|wán} is "finished, to the end": {看完|kàn wán}. {学会|xué huì} is "learn (and now can)", {做对|zuò duì} "get right", {打开|dǎ kāi} "open". The book comes first here as the topic.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I didn't understand the teacher's question.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}{老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}: {没|méi} before the verb + complement, no {了|le}, and the object after the pair (or first, as the topic: {老师|lǎo shī}{的|de}{问题|wèn tí}{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}). {不|bù} would be wrong with a result.

questions.stem: How do you ask "Have you finished (doing it)?"
questions.explanation: Verb + complement + {了|le}, then {吗|ma} at the end: {你|nǐ}{做完|zuò wán}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ ({你|nǐ}{做完|zuò wán}{了|le}{没有|méi yǒu}？ works too.) {吗|ma} is always last, {了|le} can't split the pair, and {你|nǐ}{没|méi}{做完|zuò wán}{吗|ma}？ asks "Haven't you finished?"

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Have you finished today's questions?
questions.explanation: With the object as the topic: {今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{题|tí}{你|nǐ}{做完|zuò wán}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ The object can also follow the pair: {你|nǐ}{做完|zuò wán}{了|le}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{题|tí}{吗|ma}？ or {你|nǐ}{做完|zuò wán}{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{题|tí}{了|le}{吗|ma}？

questions.stem: Choose the word: {老师|lǎo shī}，{我|wǒ}{有|yǒu}{一|yí}{个|gè} ___。 (Teacher, I've got a question.)
questions.explanation: A question you ask is a {问题|wèn tí}. {题|tí} is a question you answer in a test or an exercise ({第三|dì sān}{题|tí}, question 3); {词|cí} is a word.

questions.stem: Choose the word: {我|wǒ} ___ {了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}。 (I've forgotten his name.)
questions.explanation: "Forget" is {忘|wàng}, nearly always with {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{他|tā}{的|de}{名字|míng zi}. {记得|jì de} is the opposite, "remember", and its negative is {不|bú}{记得|jì de}.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 懂 (to understand)?
questions.explanation: 懂 is dǒng, third tone. dòng (fourth tone) is 动 (to move, lesson 20), and dōng is 东 (east), so the tone is all that separates them.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {考|kǎo} ___ (kǎoshì, exam)?
questions.explanation: Exam is 考试: 试 is 讠 (speech) + 式, which gives the sound shì. 式 alone has no 讠; 识 is the shi of {认识|rèn shi}; 词 is cí, word.

questions.stem: Which character means "to forget"?
questions.explanation: 忘 is 亡 (gone) over 心 (heart, mind): gone from the mind. 忙 (busy) has 忄 and 亡 side by side; 想 (want, think) and 怎 (how) also have 心 at the bottom.

questions.stem: Which three characters share the radical 讠 (speech)?
questions.explanation: 试, 词 and 记 all have 讠 on the left (言 in traditional script: 試 詞 記). 考 has 耂, 完 has 宀, 懂 has 忄 and 忘 and 想 have 心.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want?

audio.text: 我没听懂，请你再说一下。

choices: the other person to say it again
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}，{请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià}: I didn't understand, please say it again. {再|zài} is "again".

questions.stem: Listen. What did the speaker do?
questions.explanation: You heard {考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{题|tí}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{做完|zuò wán}{了|le}: I finished all the exam questions. The object comes first as the topic, and {都|dōu} (all) refers back to it. "Wrong" would be {做错|zuò cuò}.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?
choices: The speaker is looking for their notebook.
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{找到|zhǎo dào}{我|wǒ}{的|de}{本子|běn zi}{了|le}: {找到|zhǎo dào} is "find" (look for + reach). Still looking would be {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{找|zhǎo}….

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
choices: {考试|kǎo shì}{在|zài}{星期五|xīng qī wǔ}。
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{还|hái}{记得|jì de}{我|wǒ}{吗|ma}？ (Do you still remember me?). Answer with the verb: {记得|jì de}！ (or {不|bú}{记得|jì de}{了|le}).

questions.stem: Read: "{妈妈|mā ma}：{今天|jīn tiān}{的|de}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{考试|kǎo shì}{考完|kǎo wán}{了|le}。{听|tīng}{的|de}{题|tí}{我|wǒ}{都|dōu}{听懂|tīng dǒng}{了|le}，{但是|dàn shì}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{我|wǒ}{写错|xiě cuò}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{字|zì}。{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{九十|jiǔ shí}{分|fēn}！{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。——{小明|Xiǎo Míng}" What went wrong in the exam?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{写错|xiě cuò}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{字|zì}: he wrote two characters wrong. He understood all the listening questions ({都|dōu}{听懂|tīng dǒng}{了|le}), and {考完|kǎo wán}{了|le} says the exam is over.

questions.stem: Read the same message again: "…{老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{我|wǒ}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{九十|jiǔ shí}{分|fēn}！{晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{吃|chī}{饺子|jiǎo zi}。" What score did Xiao Ming get?
questions.explanation: {考|kǎo}{了|le}{九十|jiǔ shí}{分|fēn}: he scored 90. {九十|jiǔ shí} is nine tens; nineteen would be {十九|shí jiǔ}. Here {分|fēn} is a point.

questions.stem: A sign at the door of the exam room says: "{考试|kǎo shì}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{说话|shuō huà}。{考完|kǎo wán}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{可以|kě yǐ}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu}。" ({先|xiān}: first, before others) What does it say?
choices: Don't talk during the exam; those who finish may leave.
Nobody may leave before the end.
Students who don't understand may ask.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{不要|bú yào}{说话|shuō huà} is "please don't talk", and {考完|kǎo wán}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{可以|kě yǐ}{先|xiān}{走|zǒu} "students who have finished may leave first". {考完|kǎo wán}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué} is a {的|de} phrase describing the students.

questions.stem: Write the number in characters (pinyin with tone marks is accepted too). {你|nǐ}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{多少|duō shao}{分|fēn}？ You scored 90: {我|wǒ}{考|kǎo}{了|le} ___ {分|fēn}。
questions.explanation: Ninety is {九十|jiǔ shí}, nine tens: {我|wǒ}{考|kǎo}{了|le}{九十|jiǔ shí}{分|fēn}. Ninety-five would be {九十五|jiǔ shí wǔ}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {考试|kǎo shì}, exam: a low third tone, then a sharp fourth-tone fall. Before a fourth tone the third tone stays low, without its rise.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {词|cí}, word: the second tone, rising. {次|cì} (time, occurrence) is the same syllable with the fourth tone.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He speaks Chinese well."?
questions.explanation: {得|de} must follow the verb directly, so with an object the verb is said twice: {说|shuō}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (or {他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}). In the first choice {得|de} follows the object; the object can't sit after {得|de}; and the description goes after the verb, not before it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "She doesn't sing well."?
questions.explanation: The description after {得|de} carries the negative: {唱|chàng}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}. {不|bù} before the verb would deny the singing itself, and {没|méi} is for actions that didn't happen.

questions.stem: Choose the particle (standard written form): {请|qǐng}{你|nǐ}{慢慢|màn màn} ___ {说|shuō}。 (Please speak slowly.)
questions.explanation: Before a verb, the manner takes {地|de}: {慢慢|màn màn}{地|de}{说|shuō}. {得|de} goes after a verb ({说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}), and {的|de} before a noun. {慢慢|màn màn}{的|de}{说|shuō} is common in casual writing, but {地|de} is the standard form.

questions.stem: Choose the particle: {他|tā}{跑|pǎo} ___ {很|hěn}{快|kuài}。 (He runs fast.)
questions.explanation: After a verb, joining it to a description, the particle is {得|de}: {跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}. {地|de} comes before a verb and {的|de} before a noun; {跑|pǎo}{了|le}{很|hěn}{快|kuài} isn't a sentence.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Mum won't let me watch TV."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{妈妈|mā ma}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
{妈妈|mā ma}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
{妈妈|mā ma}{让|ràng}{不|bù}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}。
{妈妈|mā ma}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}{我|wǒ}。
questions.explanation: {让|ràng} + person + verb, with {不|bù} before {让|ràng}: {妈妈|mā ma}{不|bú}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{看|kàn}{电视|diàn shì}. {我|wǒ} is both the one {让|ràng} applies to and the one who watches. The first choice swaps the people; the person must come right after {让|ràng}.

questions.stem: Which is the right way to ask "Could you do me a favour?"
questions.explanation: {帮忙|bāng máng} is a separable verb: the person and the quantity go between its halves, {帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{忙|máng}. {帮忙|bāng máng} can't take an object, so ~~{帮忙|bāng máng}{我|wǒ}~~ is the classic mistake.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He may not come (after all)."?
questions.explanation: {可能|kě néng} goes after the subject, before the verb, and {不|bù} goes with the verb it denies: {他|tā}{可能|kě néng}{不|bù}{来|lái}{了|le}. {他|tā}{不|bù}{可能|kě néng}{来|lái} says something different: "he can't possibly come".

questions.stem: Read the chat: "{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{哪儿|nǎr}？{已经|yǐ jīng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{了|le}！ {大卫|Dà wèi}：{对不起|duì bu qǐ}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{路上|lù shang}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{到|dào}！" What does David say?
choices: He's on his way and will be there any minute.
He'll come at half past seven tomorrow.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{路上|lù shang} is "I'm on my way", and {我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{到|dào} "I'll be there right away": {就|jiù} before the verb says it will happen very soon. Wang Fang's {已经|yǐ jīng}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{了|le} means "it's already half past seven!"

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 让 (to let, to make)?
questions.explanation: 让 is ràng, fourth tone, with the curled-back r. l and y are different initials ({样|yàng} is the yang of {怎么样|zěn me yàng}).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word ___ {经|jīng} (yǐjīng, already)?
questions.explanation: Already is 已经: in 已 the last stroke starts higher and half closes the top. 己 (jǐ, self, as in {自己|zì jǐ}) is open, 巳 is fully closed, and 记 (jì) is 讠 + 己.

questions.stem: Which two characters have 巾 (cloth) at the bottom?
questions.explanation: 帮 and 希 both have 巾 at the bottom, like 师 and 常 from HSK 1. 望 has 王 at the bottom, 就 has 尤 on the right, and 让 and 记 have 讠.

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: 帮 help ({帮忙|bāng máng}), 让 let ({让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{看看|kàn kan}), 已 already ({已经|yǐ jīng}), 就 right away ({我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{来|lái}), 望 look far, hope ({希望|xī wàng}). "Self" is 己, the look-alike of 已.

questions.stem: Listen. Why didn't the speaker understand?

audio.text: 老师说得太快了，我没听懂。

questions.explanation: You heard {老师|lǎo shī}{说|shuō}{得|de}{太|tài}{快|kuài}{了|le}，{我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听懂|tīng dǒng}: the teacher spoke too fast, so I didn't understand. {说|shuō}{得|de}{太|tài}{快|kuài}{了|le} is a degree complement.

questions.stem: Listen. When does the speaker have to be home?
questions.explanation: You heard {妈妈|mā ma}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{回|huí}{家|jiā}: Mum wants me home at six. {让|ràng} + person + verb: she makes me come home.

questions.stem: Someone praises you. Listen, then choose a modest reply.
questions.explanation: You heard {你|nǐ}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{真|zhēn}{好|hǎo}！ (Your Chinese is really good!). {哪里|nǎ lǐ}{哪里|nǎ lǐ} ("where, where?") is the traditional modest reply; {谢谢|xiè xie} is also common now. {不|bú}{客气|kè qi} answers thanks, not praise.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker asking for?
questions.explanation: You heard {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{拿|ná}{一下|yí xià}{吗|ma}？: could you help me hold (take) this for a moment? {帮|bāng} + person + verb says what you help with; {拿|ná} is "take, hold".

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{大卫|Dà wèi}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}，{但是|dàn shì}{汉字|hàn zì}{写|xiě}{得|de}{不|bù}{好|hǎo}。{老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{他|tā}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{写|xiě}{二十|èr shí}{个|gè}{汉字|hàn zì}。{他|tā}{已经|yǐ jīng}{写|xiě}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}{了|le}，{现在|xiàn zài}{写|xiě}{得|de}{不错|bú cuò}。{我|wǒ}{希望|xī wàng}{他|tā}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{写|xiě}{汉字|hàn zì}。" Which statement is true?
choices: David has written characters for a year.
David now writes characters quite well.
The writer helps David write characters.
questions.explanation: {现在|xiàn zài}{写|xiě}{得|de}{不错|bú cuò}: he now writes quite well. He speaks well ({说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}), he has been practising for a month ({一|yí}{个|gè}{月|yuè}), and the writer hopes David can help him or her ({希望|xī wàng}{他|tā}{能|néng}{帮|bāng}{我|wǒ}).

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The teacher has us read the text slowly.
questions.explanation: {老师|lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{慢慢|màn màn}{地|de}{读|dú}{课文|kè wén}: {让|ràng} + person + verb, with the manner ({慢慢|màn màn}{地|de}) right before the verb it describes. ({课文|kè wén}: the text of a lesson, HSK 3.)

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I've already been learning Chinese for a year.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{学|xué}{了|le}{一|yì}{年|nián}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{了|le}: {已经|yǐ jīng} before the verb, the duration after the verb and before the object, {了|le} after the verb and again at the end (and it's still going on).

questions.stem: Write the time in characters (pinyin with tone marks is accepted too). Your mum wants you home at six: {妈妈|mā ma}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ} ___ {回|huí}{家|jiā}。
questions.explanation: Six o'clock is {六|liù}{点|diǎn}, and the time goes before the verb: {妈妈|mā ma}{让|ràng}{我|wǒ}{六|liù}{点|diǎn}{回|huí}{家|jiā}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {帮忙|bāng máng}, help out: high and level, then rising.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {已经|yǐ jīng}, already: a low third tone, then high and level.

questions.stem: Which is the usual way to say "He plays football."?
questions.explanation: Football is kicked: {踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}. {打|dǎ} is for games played with the hands or a bat ({打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}), and {玩|wán} (have fun) is heard among young speakers, but it isn't the usual verb for a sport.

questions.stem: Choose the usual verb: {我们|wǒ men}{下午|xià wǔ}{去|qù} ___ {篮球|lán qiú}{吧|ba}！ (Let's go and play basketball this afternoon!)
questions.explanation: Basketball, like tennis and table tennis, takes {打|dǎ} (hit): {打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}. Only football is kicked ({踢|tī}).

questions.stem: Which is the most natural way to say "I swam for an hour."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{了|le}。
{我|wǒ}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
questions.explanation: A duration follows the verb, and with {游泳|yóu yǒng} the simplest way is the plain verb {={游|yóu}=}: {我|wǒ}{游|yóu}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. Before the verb a time phrase says when, not how long; {游泳|yóu yǒng} already has its object, so {游泳|yóu yǒng}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí} is less natural (you may hear it in casual speech, but textbooks count it as a mistake).

questions.stem: Which sentence means "He runs fast."?
questions.explanation: Before {得|de}, use the plain verb {跑|pǎo}: {跑|pǎo}{得|de}{很|hěn}{快|kuài}. {跑步|pǎo bù} already has its object ({步|bù}), and {很|hěn} goes before the adjective.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "They played basketball for two hours."?
choices: {他们|tā men}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{篮球|lán qiú}。
{他们|tā men}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}。
{他们|tā men}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{他们|tā men}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{篮球|lán qiú}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
questions.explanation: The duration goes between the verb and its object: {打|dǎ}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}({的|de}){篮球|lán qiú}, or the verb is repeated: {打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{打|dǎ}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. The duration can't follow the object directly, and before the verb it would say when.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {我|wǒ}{运动|yùn dòng}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{运动|yùn dòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。
{我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{运动|yùn dòng}{足球|zú qiú}。
questions.explanation: {运动|yùn dòng} as a verb takes no object, the time word {每|měi}{天|tiān} goes before the verb, and the duration after it: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{运动|yùn dòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. A sport is named with its own verb ({踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}).

questions.stem: How do you ask "How long do you run every day?"
questions.explanation: The question phrase {多|duō}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān} goes where the answer goes, after the verb: {你|nǐ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{跑|pǎo}{多|duō}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}？ — {半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. {几|jǐ}{点|diǎn} asks what time, and a question word needs no {吗|ma}.

questions.stem: What is {篮球|lán qiú}?
questions.explanation: {篮球|lán qiú} is "basket ball", basketball, played with {打|dǎ}. Football is {足球|zú qiú} and table tennis {乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 足球 (football)?
questions.explanation: 足球 is zú qiú: two rising tones in a row. Keep the second one rising too; {篮球|lán qiú} has the same pattern.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: We're going to play football on Saturday.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{星期六|xīng qī liù}{去|qù}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú} (or {星期六|xīng qī liù}{我们|wǒ men}…): the time before the verb, {去|qù} then the purpose, and {踢|tī} for football.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word ___ {步|bù} (pǎobù, to go running)?
questions.explanation: Running is 跑步: 跑 is ⻊ (foot) + 包. 抱 (hug) has 扌 (hand), 泡 (bubble) has 氵 (water): the same 包, a different radical. 跟 (with, lesson 14) has ⻊ but 艮 on the right.

questions.stem: Which radical do 跑, 路 and 跟 share on the left?
questions.explanation: All three have ⻊, the form 足 (foot) takes on the left, with its last stroke rising: running, a road and following all involve the feet. 踢 (kick) and 跳 (jump) in lesson 20 have it too.

questions.stem: {=In 运 (move, as in {运动|yùn dòng}), which part is written last?=}
questions.explanation: {=辶 is always written last, even though it starts on the left: 云 first (horizontal, horizontal, the turning stroke, the dot), then 辶.=} (Traditional {+运+} has 軍 inside 辶, and 辶 is still written last.)

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker do every morning?
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{跑步|pǎo bù}: I go running every morning. Swimming would be {游泳|yóu yǒng}.

questions.stem: Listen. How long did they play?

audio.text: 他们踢了两个小时足球。

questions.explanation: You heard {他们|tā men}{踢|tī}{了|le}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}{足球|zú qiú}: they played football for two hours. The duration comes between the verb and the object.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{什么|shén me}{运动|yùn dòng}？ (What sports do you like?). Name a sport: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{游泳|yóu yǒng}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want?

audio.text: 我不会游泳，你能教我吗？

choices: to go to the pool together
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{不|bú}{会|huì}{游泳|yóu yǒng}，{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{教|jiāo}{我|wǒ}{吗|ma}？: I can't swim; could you teach me? The speaker wants to be taught ({教|jiāo}{我|wǒ}), not to teach.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{学校|xué xiào}{运动|yùn dòng}{时间|shí jiān}　{篮球|lán qiú}：{星期一|xīng qī yī}、{星期三|xīng qī sān}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}　{足球|zú qiú}：{星期二|xīng qī èr}、{星期四|xīng qī sì}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}　{游泳|yóu yǒng}：{星期五|xīng qī wǔ}{下午|xià wǔ}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}。{不|bú}{会|huì}{游泳|yóu yǒng}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{也|yě}{可以|kě yǐ}{来|lái}，{老师|lǎo shī}{教|jiāo}{你|nǐ}。" You want to play football. When do you go?
questions.explanation: {足球|zú qiú}：{星期二|xīng qī èr}、{星期四|xīng qī sì}{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}: football is on Tuesdays and Thursdays at half past four. Monday and Wednesday at four is basketball, and Friday at three swimming.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I run for half an hour every morning.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{跑|pǎo}{半|bàn}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}: time words before the verb, the duration after it, and the plain verb {跑|pǎo} before a duration. A habit takes no {了|le}.

questions.stem: Write the answer in characters (pinyin with tone marks is accepted too). {你|nǐ}{游|yóu}{了|le}{多|duō}{长|cháng}{时间|shí jiān}？ — {我|wǒ}{游|yóu}{了|le} ___。 (one hour)
questions.explanation: An hour is {一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}, with the measure word {个|gè}: {我|wǒ}{游|yóu}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. {小时|xiǎo shí} is the length of time; {点|diǎn} is the time on the clock.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {游泳|yóu yǒng}, swim: rising, then the third tone. At the end of a phrase the third tone dips and rises a little.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {运动|yùn dòng}, sport, exercise: two falling fourth tones.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Let's go together!"?
questions.explanation: {一起|yì qǐ} is an adverb, so it goes before the verb: {我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吧|ba}. English puts "together" at the end; Chinese doesn't.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I play football with my friends."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{一起|yì qǐ}{朋友|péng you}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}。
{我|wǒ}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}。
{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{一起|yì qǐ}{朋友|péng you}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}。
{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}。
questions.explanation: Who with ({跟|gēn} + person), then {一起|yì qǐ}, then the verb: {我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{朋友|péng you}{一起|yì qǐ}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}. The whole "with" phrase goes before the verb, not after it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'll wait for you at the entrance."?
questions.explanation: The place with {在|zài} goes before the verb, and the person you wait for follows {等|děng} directly, with no word for "for": {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "Let's rest for a little while."?
choices: {我们|wǒ men}{一会儿|yí huìr}{休息|xiū xi}{吧|ba}。
{我们|wǒ men}{休息|xiū xi}{吧|ba}{一会儿|yí huìr}。
{我们|wǒ men}{休息|xiū xi}{一会儿|yí huìr}{吧|ba}。
{我们|wǒ men}{一会儿|yí huìr}{吧|ba}{休息|xiū xi}。
questions.explanation: How long goes after the verb: {休息|xiū xi}{一会儿|yí huìr}, then {吧|ba} at the end. {我们|wǒ men}{一会儿|yí huìr}{休息|xiū xi}{吧|ba} means something else: "let's rest in a moment" ({一会儿|yí huìr} before the verb is "soon").

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I started learning Chinese last year."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{去年|qù nián}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{我|wǒ}{开始|kāi shǐ}{去年|qù nián}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
{我|wǒ}{去年|qù nián}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{开始|kāi shǐ}。
{去年|qù nián}{我|wǒ}{学|xué}{开始|kāi shǐ}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}。
questions.explanation: The time word before the verb, then {开始|kāi shǐ} + the action: {我|wǒ}{去年|qù nián}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}. {开始|kāi shǐ} comes before the verb it starts, like "start" + "-ing" in English.

questions.stem: What is the pinyin of 爱好 (hobby)?
questions.explanation: 爱好 is ài hào: here 好 is read hào, fourth tone, meaning "to like". It's the same character as {好|hǎo} (good), third tone.

questions.stem: How do you ask "What are your hobbies?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{的|de}{爱好|ài hào}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}{吗|ma}？
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{爱好|ài hào}？ (or {你|nǐ}{的|de}{爱好|ài hào}{是|shì}{什么|shén me}？). A noun-and-noun sentence needs {是|shì}, the question word stays in the object's place after {有|yǒu}, and a question word takes no {吗|ma}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "She dances very well."?
questions.explanation: {跳舞|tiào wǔ} is verb + object, so {得|de} follows the repeated verb: {跳舞|tiào wǔ}{跳|tiào}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo} (or simply {她|tā}{跳|tiào}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}). {得|de} can't follow the object {舞|wǔ}, and nothing goes between {得|de} and the description.

questions.stem: What does "{我|wǒ}{妹妹|mèi mei}{很|hěn}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画画儿|huà huàr}。" mean?
choices: My younger sister likes looking at pictures.
questions.explanation: {画画儿|huà huàr} is the verb {画|huà} (draw) + the noun {画儿|huàr} (a picture): to draw. Flowers are {花|huā}, first tone, and dancing is {跳舞|tiào wǔ}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: She started learning to dance last year.
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{去年|qù nián}{开始|kāi shǐ}{学|xué}{跳舞|tiào wǔ} (or {去年|qù nián}{她|tā}…): the time first, then {开始|kāi shǐ} + {学|xué} + the skill. {教|jiāo} would make her the teacher.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {开|kāi} ___ (kāishǐ, to begin)?
questions.explanation: To begin is 开始: 始 is 女 + 台. 台 alone has no 女; 治 (zhì, govern) has 氵 + 台; 姑 (gū, aunt) has 女 but 古 on the right.

questions.stem: Which character has ⺮ (bamboo) on top and 寺 underneath?
questions.explanation: {=等 (wait) is ⺮ over 寺. 笔 has 毛 under ⺮, 第 (the ordinal prefix) has a different lower part, and 篮 has 监 over 皿.=}

questions.stem: Match each character to its meaning.
questions.explanation: 踢 kick and 跳 jump both have ⻊ (foot); 舞 is the dance of {跳舞|tiào wǔ}; 画 is draw; 等 is wait. "Run" is 跑 (lesson 19), also with ⻊.

questions.stem: Listen. When does the film start?
questions.explanation: You heard {电影|diàn yǐng}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}: the film starts at eight. {开始|kāi shǐ} with no object: the film is what starts.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker ask?
choices: Wait for me a moment, I'm coming.
I'll wait for you for a while.
questions.explanation: You heard {你|nǐ}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一会儿|yí huìr}，{我|wǒ}{就|jiù}{来|lái}: wait for me a moment, I'll be right there. {等|děng} + person + {一会儿|yí huìr}, and {就|jiù} for "right away".

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{有|yǒu}{什么|shén me}{爱好|ài hào}？ (What are your hobbies?). Name one: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画画儿|huà huàr}, or {我|wǒ}{的|de}{爱好|ài hào}{是|shì}….

questions.stem: Listen. What is the plan for Saturday?

audio.text: 我们星期六一起去跳舞吧。

questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{星期六|xīng qī liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}{吧|ba}: let's go dancing together on Saturday.

questions.stem: Read the chat: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}：{星期天|xīng qī tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}{吧|ba}？ {安娜|Ān nà}：{好|hǎo}{啊|a}！{我|wǒ}{可能|kě néng}{晚|wǎn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{到|dào}，{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一会儿|yí huìr}，{好|hǎo}{吗|ma}？ {李明|Lǐ Míng}：{没问题|méi wèn tí}。{打完|dǎ wán}{球|qiú}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吃饭|chī fàn}。" Which is true?
choices: Anna will wait for Li Ming.
Li Ming will wait for Anna at the school gate.
questions.explanation: Anna asks {你|nǐ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一会儿|yí huìr}: Li Ming should wait for her at the school gate, and he agrees ({没问题|méi wèn tí}, no problem). They'll eat after playing ({打完|dǎ wán}{球|qiú}), and the game is basketball.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'll wait for you at the school gate.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}: the place with {在|zài} before the verb, then {等|děng} + the person, with no word for "for".

questions.stem: Write the missing word in characters (pinyin with tone marks is accepted too): {我们|wǒ men} ___ {去|qù}{吧|ba}！ (Let's go together!)
questions.explanation: "Together" is {一起|yì qǐ}, before the verb: {我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{吧|ba}. 一 is said yì before the third tone of 起.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {跳舞|tiào wǔ}, dance: falling, then the third tone. {舞|wǔ} sounds like {五|wǔ} (five).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {开始|kāi shǐ}, begin: high and level, then the third tone.

questions.stem: Where was table tennis invented?
questions.explanation: Table tennis was invented in England in the early 1900s and first sold as "Ping-Pong", a trade name. It spread to Japan and China soon after.

questions.stem: What is table tennis often called in China?
questions.explanation: {乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú} is often called {国球|guó qiú}, "the national ball". {足球|zú qiú} is football, {篮球|lán qiú} basketball and {羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú} badminton.

questions.stem: Choose the usual verb: {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{每|měi}{天|tiān} ___ {乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}。 (Grandad plays table tennis every day.)
questions.explanation: Games played with a bat or the hands take {打|dǎ}: {打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}, {打|dǎ}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}, {打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}. {踢|tī} is for football and the shuttlecock {毽子|jiàn zi}.

questions.stem: How is {毽子|jiàn zi} (jianzi) played?
choices: with a bat, over a net
by throwing it into a basket
with the hands, in a circle
by keeping it in the air with any part of the body except the hands
questions.explanation: A {毽子|jiàn zi} is a weighted shuttlecock with feathers. Players keep it in the air without using their hands, mostly with their feet, alone or passing it round in a circle.

questions.stem: Which verb goes with {毽子|jiàn zi}?
questions.explanation: It's kicked, so the verb is {踢|tī}, as for football: {踢|tī}{毽子|jiàn zi}, {踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}.

questions.stem: What is {广播体操|guǎng bō tǐ cāo}?
choices: a routine of exercises done together to music and counting
questions.explanation: {广播体操|guǎng bō tǐ cāo}, "broadcast exercises", is a set routine done to music and a counting voice; in many schools everyone does it together every school day. Square dancing is {广场舞|guǎng chǎng wǔ}.

questions.stem: When was China's first set of radio exercises released?
questions.explanation: The first set came out in 1951. New sets have followed from time to time; the ninth was released in 2011.

questions.stem: China's professional basketball league, the CBA, began with which season?
questions.explanation: The CBA began play in the 1995–96 season. The top football league, the Chinese Super League, started in 2004.

questions.stem: Listen. Where does Grandad play?

audio.text: 我爷爷每天早上在公园打乒乓球。

questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{爷爷|yé ye}{每|měi}{天|tiān}{早上|zǎo shang}{在|zài}{公园|gōng yuán}{打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}: every morning in the park ({公园|gōng yuán}).

questions.stem: Listen. Who does the speaker play badminton with?

audio.text: 晚上我跟妈妈在楼下打羽毛球。

questions.explanation: You heard {晚上|wǎn shang}{我|wǒ}{跟|gēn}{妈妈|mā ma}{在|zài}{楼|lóu}{下|xià}{打|dǎ}{羽毛球|yǔ máo qiú}: in the evening I play badminton with Mum downstairs. {跟|gēn} + person says who with.

questions.stem: Read: "{公园|gōng yuán}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{人|rén}{运动|yùn dòng}：{有|yǒu}{的|de}{跑步|pǎo bù}，{有|yǒu}{的|de}{跳舞|tiào wǔ}，{也|yě}{有|yǒu}{踢|tī}{毽子|jiàn zi}{的|de}。{爷爷|yé ye}{打|dǎ}{乒乓球|pīng pāng qiú}{打|dǎ}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。" Which activity is not mentioned?
questions.explanation: The text names running ({跑步|pǎo bù}), dancing ({跳舞|tiào wǔ}), kicking the shuttlecock ({踢|tī}{毽子|jiàn zi}) and Grandad's table tennis. Swimming ({游泳|yóu yǒng}) isn't there.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{爸爸|bà ba}{还|hái}{没|méi}{睡觉|shuì jiào}，{在|zài}{看|kàn}{足球|zú qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}。" ({比赛|bǐ sài}: match) What is Dad doing?
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{看|kàn}{足球|zú qiú}{比赛|bǐ sài}: he is watching a football match ({在|zài} before the verb for an action in progress), and {还|hái}{没|méi}{睡觉|shuì jiào}: he hasn't gone to bed yet.

questions.stem: How long is primary school ({小学|xiǎo xué}) in China, usually?
questions.explanation: Primary school usually lasts six years, from about age six; then come three years of junior high ({初中|chū zhōng}) and three of senior high ({高中|gāo zhōng}).

questions.stem: Which years make up the nine years of compulsory education?
choices: primary school and junior high school
questions.explanation: Primary school (six years) and junior high school (three years) together are the nine compulsory years. Senior high school comes after the {中考|zhōng kǎo}.

questions.stem: What is the {中考|zhōng kǎo}?
choices: a locally set exam at the end of junior high that decides which senior high school a pupil can go to
a Chinese language test for foreigners
the exam at the end of primary school
questions.explanation: The {中考|zhōng kǎo} is taken at the end of junior high, at about fifteen, and is set by the city or province. Its results decide the next school, senior high or vocational. The college entrance exam is the {高考|gāo kǎo}.

questions.stem: What is the {高考|gāo kǎo}?
choices: the senior high school entrance exam
questions.explanation: {高考|gāo kǎo} is short for the national college entrance examination, the main way into university: {高|gāo} for higher education + {考|kǎo}.

questions.stem: When is the gaokao held?
choices: every year in early June, starting on 7 June
questions.explanation: It starts on 7 June every year and lasts two days or more, depending on the province. September is the start of the school year, and July and August the summer holiday.

questions.stem: Which subjects does every gaokao candidate take?
choices: Chinese, mathematics and a foreign language
questions.explanation: Chinese, mathematics and a foreign language are taken by everyone; the other subjects depend on the province's rules and the pupil's choices.

questions.stem: When does the school year usually start in China?
questions.explanation: The year starts at the beginning of September ({九|jiǔ}{月|yuè}{一|yī}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué} is typical) and has two terms. The spring term starts after the winter holiday ({寒假|hán jià}), around the Spring Festival.

questions.stem: What are {眼保健操|yǎn bǎo jiàn cāo}?
choices: eye exercises: pressing and rubbing points around the eyes to music
exercises done on the sports ground
questions.explanation: {眼保健操|yǎn bǎo jiàn cāo} are eye exercises, introduced in the 1960s: pupils close their eyes and press and rub points around them to recorded music, to rest their eyes. The whole-school exercises outside are {广播体操|guǎng bō tǐ cāo}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is blue?

audio.text: 我们学校的校服是蓝色的。

questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{学校|xué xiào}{的|de}{校服|xiào fú}{是|shì}{蓝色|lán sè}{的|de}: our school uniform is blue. {校服|xiào fú} is {校|xiào} (school) + {服|fú} (clothes).

questions.stem: Listen. What will the speaker's elder brother do this year?

audio.text: 我哥哥今年高考，我们都希望他考得好。

questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{哥哥|gē ge}{今年|jīn nián}{高考|gāo kǎo}，{我们|wǒ men}{都|dōu}{希望|xī wàng}{他|tā}{考|kǎo}{得|de}{好|hǎo}: my brother takes the gaokao this year, and we all hope he does well.

questions.stem: Read: "{我们|wǒ men}{早上|zǎo shang}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}{到|dào}{学校|xué xiào}，{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开始|kāi shǐ}{上课|shàng kè}。{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{做|zuò}{广播体操|guǎng bō tǐ cāo}。{中午|zhōng wǔ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}，{休息|xiū xi}{一会儿|yí huìr}。" What do the pupils do at ten?
questions.explanation: {上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{做|zuò}{广播体操|guǎng bō tǐ cāo}: at ten they do the exercises together. They arrive at half past seven and lessons start at eight.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{寒假|hán jià}{从|cóng}{一|yī}{月|yuè}{二十|èr shí}{号|hào}{到|dào}{二|èr}{月|yuè}{二十五|èr shí wǔ}{号|hào}，{二|èr}{月|yuè}{二十六|èr shí liù}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}。" ({寒假|hán jià}: winter holiday) When does the new term start?
questions.explanation: {二|èr}{月|yuè}{二十六|èr shí liù}{号|hào}{开学|kāi xué}: term starts on 26 February. The holiday runs {从|cóng}…{到|dào}… (from… to…) 20 January to 25 February.

questions.stem: Which is the right way to ask "Are you having coffee or tea?"
choices: {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{还是|hái shi}{茶|chá}{吗|ma}？
{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}？
{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{或者|huò zhě}{茶|chá}{吗|ma}？
{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{吗|ma}{还是|hái shi}{茶|chá}？
questions.explanation: A choice question puts {还是|hái shi} between the options and takes no {吗|ma}: {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}？ Adding {吗|ma} turns it into a muddle of two question types, and {或者|huò zhě} (HSK 3) is the "or" of statements, not of questions that ask you to choose.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct? ("Are you a teacher or a student?")
choices: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{还是|hái shi}{是|shì}{学生|xué sheng}？
{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{还是|hái shi}{学生|xué sheng}{吗|ma}？
{你|nǐ}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{还是|hái shi}{学生|xué sheng}？
{你|nǐ}{老师|lǎo shī}{还是|hái shi}{学生|xué sheng}{是|shì}？
questions.explanation: {还是|hái shi} already ends in {是|shì}, so the second {是|shì} is dropped: {你|nǐ}{是|shì}{老师|lǎo shī}{还是|hái shi}{学生|xué sheng}？ No {吗|ma} in a choice question, and {是|shì} comes before the first option, not at the end.

questions.stem: Your friend is leaving the café without their phone. What do you call out? ("Don't forget your phone!")
questions.explanation: The spoken "don't" of a command is {别|bié}, right before the verb: {别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}…！ {不|bù} only makes a statement ("not forget"), {没|méi} is for what didn't happen, and {别|bié} never comes after the verb.

questions.stem: What does "{别|bié}{看|kàn}{手机|shǒu jī}{了|le}！" mean?
choices: I didn't look at my phone.
Have a look at your phone!
questions.explanation: {别|bié}…{了|le} means "stop…": the {了|le} says the situation should change. Buying would be {买|mǎi}; "I didn't look" would be {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{看|kàn}; and without {别|bié} it would be an invitation to look.

questions.stem: On a menu you see {红茶|hóng chá}. What will you get?
questions.explanation: {红茶|hóng chá} is "red tea" word for word, named for the colour of the drink, but it is what English calls black tea. Green tea is {绿茶|lǜ chá} and milk tea {奶茶|nǎi chá}.

questions.stem: Choose the verb: {我们|wǒ men} ___ {菜|cài}{吧|ba}。 (Let's order.)
questions.explanation: {点|diǎn}{菜|cài} is "to order (dishes)" in a restaurant. {做|zuò}{菜|cài} is to cook, {买|mǎi}{菜|cài} to do the food shopping, and {吃|chī}{菜|cài} to eat the dishes.

questions.stem: Which pinyin is right for 绿茶 (green tea)?
questions.explanation: 绿茶 is lǜ chá: lǜ with ü and a falling tone, then a rising chá. lù (without the dots) is a different syllable, the one in {路|lù} (road).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word 咖 ___ (kā fēi, coffee)?
questions.explanation: Coffee is 咖啡: both characters have 口 on the left, a sign that they are written for their sound. 非 alone (as in {非常|fēi cháng}) is the sound part without 口; 排 (pái, to line up) has the hand radical; 悲 (bēi, sad) has 心 underneath.

questions.stem: Which character is bié (don't)?
questions.explanation: {=别 has 口 and a hooked part on the left and the knife radical 刂 on the right. 另 (lìng, another) is only its left side; 利 (lì, sharp) has 禾 on the left; {到|dào} (to arrive) has 至.=}

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker asking?
choices: which you're having, coffee or tea
questions.explanation: You heard {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}{还是|hái shi}{喝|hē}{茶|chá}？, a choice question: coffee or tea? "Do you like coffee?" would be {你|nǐ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{咖啡|kā fēi}{吗|ma}？

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want you to remember?

audio.text: 别忘了，我们七点去看电影。

questions.explanation: You heard {别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{七|qī}{点|diǎn}{去|qù}{看|kàn}{电影|diàn yǐng}: don't forget, we're going to the cinema at seven. {七|qī} (seven) and {一|yī} (one) both have the -i sound; listen for the q.

questions.stem: Listen to the server. Which is the best reply?
questions.explanation: The server asked a choice question: large or small? You answer by naming your choice, {小杯|xiǎo bēi} (or {大杯|dà bēi}). "Yes" ({是|shì}{的|de}) and {我|wǒ}{要|yào} don't choose anything.

questions.stem: Read the message: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}。{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{不错|bú cuò}，{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{十八|shí bā}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{还是|hái shi}{绿茶|lǜ chá}？{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{点|diǎn}。{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}{了|le}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}{吧|ba}。" Where is the writer?
choices: in a café at the school gate
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}: "I'm at the café at the school gate". The metro and the taxi are how Li Ming might come.

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}。{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{不错|bú cuò}，{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{十八|shí bā}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{还是|hái shi}{绿茶|lǜ chá}？{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{点|diǎn}。{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}{了|le}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}{吧|ba}。" What does the writer ask Li Ming?
choices: whether he wants milk tea or green tea
how much a milk tea costs
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{还是|hái shi}{绿茶|lǜ chá}？ is a choice question: milk tea or green tea? The price, 18 kuai, is given, not asked.

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{李明|Lǐ Míng}，{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}。{这儿|zhèr}{的|de}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{不错|bú cuò}，{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{十八|shí bā}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{喝|hē}{奶茶|nǎi chá}{还是|hái shi}{绿茶|lǜ chá}？{我|wǒ}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{点|diǎn}。{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}{了|le}，{路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}，{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}{吧|ba}。" How should Li Ming come, and why?
choices: by car, because there's no traffic
by metro, because there's a lot of traffic
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{打车|dǎ chē}{了|le}: don't bother with a taxi; {路上|lù shang}{车|chē}{很|hěn}{多|duō}: the roads are busy; {坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}{吧|ba}: come by metro.

questions.stem: Build the question in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Do you want black tea or green tea?
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{要|yào}{红茶|hóng chá}{还是|hái shi}{绿茶|lǜ chá}？ The options go on either side of {还是|hái shi}; no {吗|ma}, and not {或者|huò zhě}, which is for statements.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Don't drink too much coffee.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{喝|hē}{太|tài}{多|duō}{咖啡|kā fēi}。 {别|bié} goes right before the verb; {太|tài}{多|duō} (too much) comes before the noun it describes. {不|bù} and {没|méi} can't give an order.

questions.stem: You're ordering at a café. Write the drink "coffee" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}___。
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{要|yào}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。 Both characters have 口 on the left: 咖 (8 strokes) and 啡 (11 strokes). In pinyin, two first tones: kā fēi (type ka1 fei1).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {咖啡|kā fēi}, coffee: tones 1 + 1, both high and level. Keep the second syllable up.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {红茶|hóng chá}, black tea: tones 2 + 2, rising twice.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {奶茶|nǎi chá}, milk tea: tones 3 + 2. Before the rising {茶|chá}, {奶|nǎi} is a low half third that doesn't climb back up.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "This dish is so good!"?
choices: {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{这么|zhè me}{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī}！
{这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}！
{这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{好吃|hǎo chī}！
{这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{很|hěn}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}！
questions.explanation: {这么|zhè me} goes straight before the adjective and takes the place of {很|hěn}: {这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}. Using both is a mistake, and {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de} goes before a noun ("a dish like this"), not before an adjective.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I'd like to buy a watch like that."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{那样|nà yàng}{的|de}{手表|shǒu biǎo}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{那么|nà me}{的|de}{手表|shǒu biǎo}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{手表|shǒu biǎo}{那样|nà yàng}{的|de}。
{我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{那样|nà yàng}{手表|shǒu biǎo}{的|de}。
questions.explanation: "A … like that" is {那样|nà yàng} + {的|de} + noun, all before the noun: {那样|nà yàng}{的|de}{手表|shǒu biǎo}. {那么|nà me} is for degree before an adjective ({那么|nà me}{贵|guì}), and a describing phrase never follows its noun.

questions.stem: Choose the measure word: {我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{这|zhè} ___ {鱼|yú}{吧|ba}。 (Let's order this fish.)
