questions.explanation: Fish are long and thin, so they take {条|tiáo}: {这|zhè}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}, {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}. So do trousers and roads. {本|běn} is for books and {件|jiàn} for clothes (tops) and matters; {个|gè} doesn't fit a fish.

questions.stem: A dish costs somewhere between 21 and 29 kuai. How do you say "twenty-odd kuai"?
questions.explanation: After a round number, {多|duō} goes before the measure word: {二十多|èr shí duō}{块|kuài}, 21 to 29. {二十|èr shí}{块|kuài}{多|duō} is a different amount, twenty kuai and some change (20.10–20.90). {多|duō} never comes first, and {几|jǐ} and {多|duō} don't combine.

questions.stem: What does "{十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}" mean?
choices: a dozen or so people (11 to 19)
questions.explanation: {十几|shí jǐ} is "ten and a few": somewhere between 11 and 19. A few dozen is {几十|jǐ shí} (the other way round), and one or two would be {一两|yì liǎng}{个|gè}.

questions.stem: We waited "an hour and a bit". Which is right?
questions.explanation: With a number from one to nine, {多|duō} goes after the measure word: {一|yí}{个|gè}{多|duō}{小时|xiǎo shí}, like {三|sān}{块|kuài}{多|duō}. Only round numbers (ten, twenty, a hundred) put {多|duō} straight after the number.

questions.stem: A friend says the fish is expensive but big enough for four. You answer: "{那么|nà me}，{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{吧|ba}。" What does {那么|nà me} mean here?
questions.explanation: At the start of a sentence {那么|nà me} means "then, in that case", drawing a conclusion from what was just said; it's often shortened to {那|nà}. Before an adjective it would mean "so, that" ({那么|nà me}{贵|guì}).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {饭|fàn} ___ (fàn guǎn, restaurant)?
questions.explanation: {=馆 = the food radical 饣 + 官 (guān), the sound part. 官 alone means an official; 管 (guǎn, to manage, later) has the bamboo radical on top; 饱 (bǎo, full, HSK 3) has 饣 too but 包 on the right.=}

questions.stem: Which character means "fish"?
questions.explanation: {=鱼 is a fish standing on its tail: the head at the top, the scaly body (田) and the tail. 鸟 is a bird (lesson 25), 角 (jiǎo, horn; HSK 3) has no tail stroke, and 色 is the colour character of {颜色|yán sè}.=}

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think?
choices: They want a dish like this one.
questions.explanation: You heard {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}！ "This dish is so good!" {这么|zhè me} before an adjective is "so". "Too expensive" would be {太|tài}{贵|guì}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Listen. How many people are in the restaurant?
questions.explanation: You heard {十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}: a dozen or so, 11 to 19. Several dozen would be {几十|jǐ shí}, and two or three {两三|liǎng sān}.

questions.stem: Listen. How much is the fish?
questions.explanation: You heard {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{一百多|yì bǎi duō}{块|kuài}: over a hundred, somewhere between 101 and 199. Ten-odd would be {十多|shí duō}, and two or three hundred {两三百|liǎng sān bǎi}.

questions.stem: Read: "{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{去|qù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{三十多|sān shí duō}{个|gè}{人|rén}。{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{和|hé}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{肉|ròu}{菜|cài}，{三|sān}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{一百多|yì bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{鱼|yú}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}。{但是|dàn shì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{人|rén}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{等|děng}{了|le}{四十多|sì shí duō}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。" How many people can the restaurant seat?
questions.explanation: {能|néng}{坐|zuò}{三十多|sān shí duō}{个|gè}{人|rén}: it seats thirty-odd people. "A hundred-odd" ({一百多|yì bǎi duō}) is the price of the three dishes.

questions.stem: Read the text again: "{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{去|qù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{三十多|sān shí duō}{个|gè}{人|rén}。{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{和|hé}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{肉|ròu}{菜|cài}，{三|sān}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{一百多|yì bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{鱼|yú}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}。{但是|dàn shì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{人|rén}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{等|děng}{了|le}{四十多|sì shí duō}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。" What did they order?
choices: two fish and a meat dish
a fish and two meat dishes
a fish and two bowls of rice
questions.explanation: {一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{和|hé}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{肉|ròu}{菜|cài}: one fish (counted with {条|tiáo}) and two meat dishes (counted with {个|gè}): three dishes in all.

questions.stem: Read the text again: "{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{朋友|péng you}{去|qù}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{新|xīn}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}。{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{不|bú}{大|dà}，{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{三十多|sān shí duō}{个|gè}{人|rén}。{我们|wǒ men}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{一|yì}{条|tiáo}{鱼|yú}{和|hé}{两|liǎng}{个|gè}{肉|ròu}{菜|cài}，{三|sān}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{一百多|yì bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{鱼|yú}{这么|zhè me}{好吃|hǎo chī}，{我|wǒ}{下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{还|hái}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}。{但是|dàn shì}{晚上|wǎn shang}{人|rén}{太|tài}{多|duō}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{等|děng}{了|le}{四十多|sì shí duō}{分钟|fēn zhōng}。" How long did they wait?
questions.explanation: {等|děng}{了|le}{四十多|sì shí duō}{分钟|fēn zhōng}: forty-odd minutes, between 41 and 49. Fourteen would be {十四|shí sì}, and hours are {小时|xiǎo shí}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: There are a dozen or so people in the restaurant.
questions.explanation: Place + {有|yǒu} + number + measure word + noun: {饭馆|fàn guǎn}{里|lǐ}{有|yǒu}{十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}。 {十几|shí jǐ} stays in front of the measure word, like any number.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'd like trousers like these too.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{想|xiǎng}{要|yào}{这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}{裤子|kù zi}。 {也|yě} goes before the verbs; "like these" before a noun is {这样|zhè yàng}{的|de}, not {这么|zhè me}.

questions.stem: Write the quantity "twenty-odd" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这个|zhè ge}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{能|néng}{坐|zuò} ___ {个|gè}{人|rén}。
questions.explanation: {这个|zhè ge}{饭馆|fàn guǎn}{能|néng}{坐|zuò}{二十多|èr shí duō}{个|gè}{人|rén}。 Twenty is {二十|èr shí} (with {二|èr}, not {两|liǎng}), and {多|duō} follows the round number, before {个|gè}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {饭馆|fàn guǎn}, restaurant: tones 4 + 3, a fall and then a dip, as in {米饭|mǐ fàn}'s {饭|fàn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {牛肉|niú ròu}, beef: tones 2 + 4, a rise and then a strong fall.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {鱼|yú}, fish: the second tone, rising. {雨|yǔ} (rain) has the third tone.

questions.stem: How do you say 100,000 in Chinese?
questions.explanation: Chinese counts in fours: 10,000 is {一万|yí wàn}, so 100,000 is ten of them, {十万|shí wàn}. There is no "hundred thousand" with {千|qiān}; {一千|yì qiān}{万|wàn} would be ten million.

questions.stem: A price tag says ¥25,000. How do you read it?
questions.explanation: Count four digits from the right: 2 | 5000, so {两万|liǎng wàn}{五千|wǔ qiān} (said short, {两万五|liǎng wàn wǔ}). {两千|liǎng qiān}{五百|wǔ bǎi} is 2,500, and {千|qiān} can't be counted up to twenty-five.

questions.stem: How do you read 10,500?
questions.explanation: The thousands place is empty, so {零|líng} fills it: {一万|yí wàn}{零|líng}{五百|wǔ bǎi}. {一万五|yí wàn wǔ} is 15,000 said short, and {十万|shí wàn} is 100,000.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's about to rain."?
choices: {明天|míng tiān}{快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {快要|kuài yào} + verb + {了|le}: {快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。 The {了|le} can't be left out, {快要|kuài yào} doesn't go with an exact time such as {明天|míng tiān}, and it comes before the verb.

questions.stem: Which question means "How much did you spend?"
questions.explanation: The amount replaces the plain object: {花|huā}{了|le}{多少|duō shao}{钱|qián}, with {了|le} right after the verb. {花钱|huā qián} + an amount, or the amount before the verb, isn't Chinese order.

questions.stem: A sign in a shop says {打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}. What does it mean?
questions.explanation: The number is what you pay, in tenths: {八|bā}{折|zhé} is eight tenths of the price, so 20% off. {打|dǎ}{五|wǔ}{折|zhé} would be half price.

questions.stem: Your friend says: "{我|wǒ}{正|zhèng}{想|xiǎng}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}！" What do they mean?
choices: I don't want to call you.
Call me at exactly the right time.
I was just going to call you!
questions.explanation: {正|zhèng} + {想|xiǎng} is "was just about to, was just thinking of": you've called at the very moment they meant to call you.

questions.stem: What does "{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{包|bāo}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{吧|ba}！" mean?
choices: Let's put the dumplings in a bag!
questions.explanation: {包|bāo} as a verb is "to wrap", and {包|bāo}{饺子|jiǎo zi} (wrap the filling in dough) is the normal way to say "make dumplings". Buns are {包子|bāo zi}.

questions.stem: Which activity does NOT take {打|dǎ}?
questions.explanation: Football is kicked: {踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}. The others all take {打|dǎ}: {打电话|dǎ diàn huà}, {打车|dǎ chē}, {打|dǎ}{篮球|lán qiú}.

questions.stem: Which character is wàn (ten thousand) in simplified script?
questions.explanation: {=万 is three strokes: the horizontal, the hooked stroke, then the left-falling stroke. 方 (fāng) has a dot on top; 力 (lì, strength) and 刀 (dāo, knife) have no top horizontal.=} The traditional form is {+万+}, 13 strokes.

questions.stem: Listen. How much is the computer?
questions.explanation: You heard {一万|yí wàn}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}: one {万|wàn} (10,000) and two thousand, 12,000. 1,200 would be {一千两百|yì qiān liǎng bǎi}, and 120,000 {十二万|shí èr wàn}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is happening?
choices: The shopping centre has just opened.
The shopping centre is closed today.
The shopping centre is very big.
The shopping centre is about to close.
questions.explanation: You heard {商场|shāng chǎng}{快要|kuài yào}{关门|guān mén}{了|le}: {快要|kuài yào}…{了|le} is "about to". {关门|guān mén} is to close; "has just opened" would need {开门|kāi mén}.

questions.stem: Listen. What happened?

audio.text: 我们花了三个小时，什么都没买。

choices: They spent three hours and bought nothing.
questions.explanation: You heard {花|huā}{了|le}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}: they spent three hours, and {什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{没|méi}{买|mǎi}, didn't buy anything. {花|huā} works with time as well as money.

questions.stem: Read the notice: "{这|zhè}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}。{在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{花|huā}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}，{送|sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo}。{星期六|xīng qī liù}{和|hé}{星期天|xīng qī tiān}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}。{一|yī}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}，{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{累|lèi}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{去|qù}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。" What is 20% off this week?
choices: the clothes on the third floor
the bags on the first floor
questions.explanation: {商场|shāng chǎng}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}: the clothes on the third floor, at 80% of the price. The bag is a gift, and the café is on the first floor.

questions.stem: Read the notice again: "{这|zhè}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}。{在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{花|huā}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}，{送|sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo}。{星期六|xīng qī liù}{和|hé}{星期天|xīng qī tiān}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}。{一|yī}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}，{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{累|lèi}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{去|qù}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。" How do you get a free bag?
choices: spend two thousand kuai in the shopping centre
buy clothes on the third floor
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{花|huā}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}，{送|sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo}: spend 2,000 kuai and they give you a bag ({送|sòng}: to give as a present).

questions.stem: Read the notice again: "{这|zhè}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}。{在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{花|huā}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}，{送|sòng}{一|yí}{个|gè}{包|bāo}。{星期六|xīng qī liù}{和|hé}{星期天|xīng qī tiān}，{商场|shāng chǎng}{早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}。{一|yī}{楼|lóu}{有|yǒu}{咖啡|kā fēi}{店|diàn}，{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{累|lèi}{了|le}，{可以|kě yǐ}{去|qù}{喝|hē}{一|yì}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi}。" When is the shopping centre open at the weekend?
questions.explanation: {早上|zǎo shang}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}，{晚上|wǎn shang}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{关门|guān mén}: it opens at nine in the morning and closes at ten at night.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Our film is about to start.
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{的|de}{电影|diàn yǐng}{快要|kuài yào}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}。 {快要|kuài yào} before the verb, {了|le} at the end; an exact time like {明天|míng tiān} doesn't go with {快要|kuài yào}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I spent two thousand kuai.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{花|huā}{了|le}{两千|liǎng qiān}{块|kuài}{钱|qián}。 {了|le} follows {花|huā}, then the amount; {钱|qián} at the end is optional. Before {千|qiān} the number two is {两|liǎng}.

questions.stem: Write the price "ten thousand" (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {这|zhè}{个|gè}{手机|shǒu jī} ___ {块|kuài}。
questions.explanation: {这|zhè}{个|gè}{手机|shǒu jī}{一万|yí wàn}{块|kuài}。 {=万 is three strokes, with no dot on top (that would be 方).=} Say {一|yī} as yí before the fourth tone of {万|wàn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {商场|shāng chǎng}, shopping centre: tones 1 + 3, high and level, then a dip. {上|shàng} (falling) is a different syllable.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {一万|yí wàn}, ten thousand: {一|yī} changes to the second tone before the fourth tone of {万|wàn}, so you hear 2 + 4.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {花钱|huā qián}, to spend money: tones 1 + 2, high and level, then rising.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I often buy things online."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{经常|jīng cháng}{在|zài}{上网|shàng wǎng}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}。
{我|wǒ}{经常|jīng cháng}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}。
{我|wǒ}{经常|jīng cháng}{网上|wǎng shàng}{在|zài}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}。
{我|wǒ}{经常|jīng cháng}{买|mǎi}{东西|dōng xi}{上网|shàng wǎng}。
questions.explanation: {网上|wǎng shàng} is the place ("on the net"), so it goes after {在|zài} and before the verb: {在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}. {上网|shàng wǎng} is a verb, "to go online", and can't follow {在|zài} as a place.

questions.stem: Complete: {他|tā}{每天|měi tiān} ___ {三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}。 (He's online three hours a day.)
questions.explanation: You need a verb before the length of time: {上网|shàng wǎng}{三|sān}{个|gè}{小时|xiǎo shí}. {网上|wǎng shàng} and {在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng} are places, and a place can't take a duration.

questions.stem: A notice says "during class". Which is the written form?
questions.explanation: The written "when" is {时|shí} straight after the verb phrase, with no {的|de}: {上课|shàng kè}{时|shí}. The spoken form is {上课|shàng kè}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}; {的|de} goes with {时候|shí hou}, never with {时|shí}.

questions.stem: How do you say "two weeks" with {周|zhōu}?
questions.explanation: {周|zhōu} takes no measure word, so it's just {两周|liǎng zhōu}, with {两|liǎng} as before any counted noun. With {星期|xīng qī} you need {个|gè}: {两|liǎng}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}. {周二|zhōu èr} would be Tuesday.

questions.stem: Which is "Sunday" in the {周|zhōu} style?
questions.explanation: The days are {周一|zhōu yī} to {周六|zhōu liù}, and Sunday is {周日|zhōu rì}. {周天|zhōu tiān} is heard in casual speech but isn't standard ({天|tiān} for Sunday belongs with {星期|xīng qī}: {星期天|xīng qī tiān}), and there's no "day seven". {周末|zhōu mò} (HSK 3) is the weekend.

questions.stem: A classmate asks you out tonight, but you're busy. What do you say? ("I've got something on this evening.")
choices: {我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{有|yǒu}{东西|dōng xi}。
{我|wǒ}{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{没事|méi shì}。
questions.explanation: {有|yǒu}{事|shì}, "to have something on", is the set phrase, with the short {事|shì}. {东西|dōng xi} is a thing you can hold, and {没事|méi shì} would mean you're free.

questions.stem: What does "{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{事情|shì qing}{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{告诉|gào su}{他|tā}。" mean?
choices: Don't tell him about this piece of clothing.
questions.explanation: {事情|shì qing} is a matter, counted with {件|jiàn}, the measure word clothes use too. {别|bié}{告诉|gào su}{他|tā}: don't tell him. The matter is put first as the topic.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word {事|shì} ___ (shì qing, matter)?
questions.explanation: {=All four have 青 as the sound part. 情 has the heart radical 忄 (feelings, situations). 请 (please) has 讠, speech; 晴 (sunny, lesson 25) has 日, the sun; 清 (qīng, clear; HSK 3) has 氵, water.=}

questions.stem: Which character is wǎng (net)?
questions.explanation: {=网 is a frame with two crosses inside, like the cords of a net. {同|tóng} has 一 and 口 inside, {问|wèn} is 口 in a door (门), and 用 (yòng, to use; HSK 3) has two horizontals and a vertical inside.=}

questions.stem: Listen. When is the exam?
questions.explanation: You heard {下周三|xià zhōu sān}: {下周|xià zhōu} is next week, and {周三|zhōu sān} Wednesday. This week would be {这周|zhè zhōu}, last week {上周|shàng zhōu}, and Monday {周一|zhōu yī}.

questions.stem: Listen to the announcement. What does it ask?
choices: Turn your phone on after class.
Don't play with your phone during class.
questions.explanation: You heard {上课|shàng kè}{时|shí}{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{玩|wán}{手机|shǒu jī}: {上课|shàng kè}{时|shí} is "during class" (written style), and {请|qǐng}{别|bié} is a polite "please don't".

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?
choices: It says online that it'll rain tomorrow.
questions.explanation: You heard {网上|wǎng shàng}{说|shuō}{明天|míng tiān}{下雨|xià yǔ}: "online says tomorrow rains", the everyday way to say "it says online that…". {网上|wǎng shàng} is the place where it says so.

questions.stem: Read the chat: "{李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:02 {大卫|Dà wèi}，{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{上网|shàng wǎng}{吗|ma}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:05 {在|zài}。{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？ / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:06 {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{书包|shū bāo}，{三百多|sān bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:10 {不错|bú cuò}！{但是|dàn shì}{这周六|zhè zhōu liù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{了|le}。 / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:12 {好|hǎo}{的|de}，{那|nà}{我们|wǒ men}{周六|zhōu liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{吧|ba}。" What has Li Ming seen online?
choices: a phone for three hundred kuai
a bag for three thousand kuai
a school bag for three hundred-odd kuai
questions.explanation: {一|yí}{个|gè}{书包|shū bāo}，{三百多|sān bǎi duō}{块|kuài}: a school bag for a little over three hundred kuai. {多|duō} after the round number makes it "three hundred-odd".

questions.stem: Read the chat again: "{李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:02 {大卫|Dà wèi}，{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{上网|shàng wǎng}{吗|ma}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:05 {在|zài}。{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？ / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:06 {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{书包|shū bāo}，{三百多|sān bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:10 {不错|bú cuò}！{但是|dàn shì}{这周六|zhè zhōu liù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{了|le}。 / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:12 {好|hǎo}{的|de}，{那|nà}{我们|wǒ men}{周六|zhōu liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{吧|ba}。" Why does David tell him not to buy it online?
choices: The shopping centre has a 20% discount this Saturday.
questions.explanation: {这周六|zhè zhōu liù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}: this Saturday the shopping centre has 20% off, so {你|nǐ}{别|bié}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{了|le} (don't bother buying it online).

questions.stem: Read the chat again: "{李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:02 {大卫|Dà wèi}，{你|nǐ}{在|zài}{上网|shàng wǎng}{吗|ma}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:05 {在|zài}。{什么|shén me}{事|shì}？ / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:06 {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{看|kàn}{了|le}{一|yí}{个|gè}{书包|shū bāo}，{三百多|sān bǎi duō}{块|kuài}。{你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？ / {大卫|Dà wèi} 18:10 {不错|bú cuò}！{但是|dàn shì}{这周六|zhè zhōu liù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{打|dǎ}{八|bā}{折|zhé}，{你|nǐ}{别|bié}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{了|le}。 / {李明|Lǐ Míng} 18:12 {好|hǎo}{的|de}，{那|nà}{我们|wǒ men}{周六|zhōu liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{吧|ba}。" What do they decide to do?
choices: go to the café on Saturday
go to the shopping centre together on Saturday
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{周六|zhōu liù}{一起|yì qǐ}{去|qù}{商场|shāng chǎng}{吧|ba}: let's go to the shopping centre together on Saturday. {好|hǎo}{的|de} at the start is the usual "OK" in messages.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I often buy books online.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{经常|jīng cháng}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{书|shū}。 The frequency adverb {经常|jīng cháng} comes first, then the place {在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}, then the verb. {上网|shàng wǎng} is a verb, not the place.

questions.stem: Build the notice in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Please don't play with your phone during class.
questions.explanation: {上课|shàng kè}{时|shí}{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{玩|wán}{手机|shǒu jī}。 The time phrase {上课|shàng kè}{时|shí} comes first, with no {的|de}; {请|qǐng}{别|bié} is a polite "please don't".

questions.stem: Write the time "next Wednesday" using {周|zhōu} (characters, or pinyin with tone marks): {我们|wǒ men} ___ {考试|kǎo shì}。
questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{下周三|xià zhōu sān}{考试|kǎo shì}。 {下周|xià zhōu} is next week, and the days count from {周一|zhōu yī} (Monday), so Wednesday is {周三|zhōu sān}. {下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{三|sān} says the same.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {上网|shàng wǎng}, to go online: tones 4 + 3, a fall and then a dip.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {网上|wǎng shàng}, online: tones 3 + 4, the same two syllables as {上网|shàng wǎng} in the other order. Before the fall, {网|wǎng} is a low half third.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {事情|shì qing}, matter: a falling fourth tone, then a light neutral tone. On its own 情 is qíng.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "The sky is very clear today."?
questions.explanation: {晴|qíng} is an adjective, so like {冷|lěng} and {热|rè} it takes {很|hěn}, not {是|shì}: {今天|jīn tiān}{天|tiān}{很|hěn}{晴|qíng}。 With {是|shì} you need the noun: {今天|jīn tiān}{是|shì}{晴天|qíng tiān}, the most usual way to say it.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I've loved birds ever since I was little (and still do)."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}。
{从小|cóng xiǎo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}。
questions.explanation: {从小|cóng xiǎo} ("since childhood") is an adverb before the verb, usually with {就|jiù}: it began then and still holds. {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} only says "back then", and {从小|cóng xiǎo} can neither go at the end nor take {的|de}{时候|shí hou}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "When I was little I lived in Beijing."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}。
{我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{的|de}{时候|shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}。
{我|wǒ}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}。
questions.explanation: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} is a time word, so it goes before the verb, like {去年|qù nián}. {小时|xiǎo shí} alone is "an hour", and {从小|cóng xiǎo} doesn't combine with {的|de}{时候|shí hou}.

questions.stem: Your friend says: "{我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}。" What does that tell you?
choices: They have always liked birds and still do.
They liked birds as a child, and may not now.
They watched birds for an hour.
questions.explanation: {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} places the liking back in childhood; it says nothing about now, and often suggests it has changed. "Have always liked, and still do" would be {我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I like coffee, milk tea, that kind of thing."?
choices: {我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{什么|shén me}{的|de}{咖啡|kā fēi}、{奶茶|nǎi chá}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}、{奶茶|nǎi chá}{的|de}{什么|shén me}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}、{奶茶|nǎi chá}{什么|shén me}{的|de}。
{我|wǒ}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{喝|hē}{咖啡|kā fēi}、{奶茶|nǎi chá}{什么|shén me}。
questions.explanation: {什么|shén me}{的|de} ("and so on") is a fixed phrase that comes right after the last item of the list. It can't go before the list, its two parts can't swap, and {什么|shén me} alone at the end would sound like a question.

questions.stem: A weather app says: "{明天|míng tiān}：{阴|yīn}，{下午|xià wǔ}{有|yǒu}{雨|yǔ}，3–10{度|dù}。" ({度|dù}: degrees) What will tomorrow be like?
choices: overcast, with rain in the afternoon
overcast in the morning, then sunny
questions.explanation: {阴|yīn} is overcast, and {下午|xià wǔ}{有|yǒu}{雨|yǔ} is forecast style for "rain in the afternoon". Sunny would be {晴|qíng}, and snow {雪|xuě}.

questions.stem: What does "{天|tiān}{阴|yīn}{了|le}，{快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。" mean?
choices: It's clouded over; it's about to rain.
The sky has cleared after the rain.
questions.explanation: {天|tiān}{阴|yīn}{了|le}: the sky has become overcast (change-of-state {了|le}); {快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}: it's about to rain. "It has cleared" would be {天|tiān}{晴|qíng}{了|le}.

questions.stem: Which character completes the word ___ {天|tiān} (qíng tiān, a sunny day)?
questions.explanation: Sunny is 晴, with 日 (the sun) on the left and 青 for the sound. {请|qǐng} has the speech radical, {情|qíng} the heart, and 清 (qīng, clear; HSK 3) water.

questions.stem: Which character is niǎo (bird)?
questions.explanation: {=鸟 has five strokes, with a dot for the eye. 乌 (wū, crow) has no dot, 马 is {马|mǎ} (horse, HSK 3), and 岛 (dǎo, island) has 山 at the bottom.=}

questions.stem: Which two characters share 日 (the sun) as their radical?
questions.explanation: {=晴 (sunny) and {明|míng} (bright) both have 日 on the left. 情 and 请 share their sound part 青 but have different radicals (忄, 讠); 阴 has 阝.=}

questions.stem: Listen to the forecast. What will the weather be like?
choices: overcast in the morning, sunny in the afternoon
sunny in the morning, overcast in the afternoon
questions.explanation: You heard {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{晴|qíng}，{下午|xià wǔ}{阴|yīn}: sunny in the morning ({上午|shàng wǔ}), overcast in the afternoon ({下午|xià wǔ}).

questions.stem: Listen. What do you learn about him?
choices: He played football only as a child.
He's loved football ever since he was little.
questions.explanation: You heard {他|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{踢|tī}{足球|zú qiú}: {从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù} means it started in childhood and has lasted.

questions.stem: Listen. Where did the speaker live?
questions.explanation: You heard {我|wǒ}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}: when I was little I lived in Beijing. {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} is one word, "in childhood", not {小时|xiǎo shí} (an hour).

questions.stem: Read: "{宋佳|Sòng Jiā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}，{那儿|nàr}{经常|jīng cháng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{阴天|yīn tiān}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{她|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}，{鸟|niǎo}、{花|huā}、{猫|māo}{什么|shén me}{的|de}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{画|huà}。{现在|xiàn zài}{她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}。{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{晴天|qíng tiān}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{多|duō}，{她|tā}{经常|jīng cháng}{去|qù}{外面|wài miàn}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}。" ({上海|Shàng hǎi}: Shanghai) What was the weather like where Song Jia grew up?
choices: It rained a lot, with many overcast days.
questions.explanation: {那儿|nàr}{经常|jīng cháng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{阴天|yīn tiān}{很|hěn}{多|duō}: it often rained there and there were many overcast days.

questions.stem: Read the text again: "{宋佳|Sòng Jiā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}，{那儿|nàr}{经常|jīng cháng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{阴天|yīn tiān}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{她|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}，{鸟|niǎo}、{花|huā}、{猫|māo}{什么|shén me}{的|de}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{画|huà}。{现在|xiàn zài}{她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}。{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{晴天|qíng tiān}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{多|duō}，{她|tā}{经常|jīng cháng}{去|qù}{外面|wài miàn}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}。" What has she loved doing since childhood?
choices: drawing: birds, flowers, cats and so on
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}: she has loved drawing since she was little. Birds, flowers and cats are what she draws; {什么|shén me}{的|de} adds "and so on".

questions.stem: Read the text again: "{宋佳|Sòng Jiā}{小时候|xiǎo shí hou}{住|zhù}{在|zài}{上海|Shàng hǎi}，{那儿|nàr}{经常|jīng cháng}{下雨|xià yǔ}，{阴天|yīn tiān}{很|hěn}{多|duō}。{她|tā}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}，{鸟|niǎo}、{花|huā}、{猫|māo}{什么|shén me}{的|de}，{她|tā}{都|dōu}{画|huà}。{现在|xiàn zài}{她|tā}{在|zài}{北京|Běi jīng}{上|shàng}{大学|dà xué}。{北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{晴天|qíng tiān}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{多|duō}，{她|tā}{经常|jīng cháng}{去|qù}{外面|wài miàn}{画|huà}{画儿|huàr}。" Why does she often draw outside now?
choices: Beijing has more sunny days than Shanghai.
She lives next to a park.
questions.explanation: {北京|Běi jīng}{的|de}{晴天|qíng tiān}{比|bǐ}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{多|duō}: Beijing has more sunny days than Shanghai (A {比|bǐ} B + adjective), so she often goes outside to draw.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I've loved birds ever since I was little.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{从小|cóng xiǎo}{就|jiù}{喜欢|xǐ huan}{鸟|niǎo}。 {从小|cóng xiǎo} sits after the subject and before the verb; {就|jiù} is common but can be left out. {小时候|xiǎo shí hou} would only say "as a child".

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: The sky has cleared, and there are lots of birds outside.
questions.explanation: {天|tiān}{晴|qíng}{了|le}，{外面|wài miàn}{有|yǒu}{很|hěn}{多|duō}{鸟|niǎo}。 The change-of-state {了|le} after {晴|qíng} says the sky has just cleared; then place + {有|yǒu} + what is there.

questions.stem: You're writing tomorrow's weather in a message. Write the word "sunny" (character, or pinyin with tone mark): {明天|míng tiān}___，{不|bù}{冷|lěng}。
questions.explanation: {明天|míng tiān}{晴|qíng}，{不|bù}{冷|lěng}。 晴 = 日 (sun) + 青, twelve strokes; the pinyin is qíng (type qing2). In a forecast it needs no {很|hěn}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {晴天|qíng tiān}, a sunny day: tones 2 + 1, rising, then high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {阴天|yīn tiān}, an overcast day: tones 1 + 1, both high and level.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {小鸟|xiǎo niǎo}, little bird: written 3 + 3. Third-tone sandhi: the first is said rising, so you hear 2 + 3; both answers count.

questions.stem: What is {川菜|chuān cài}?
questions.explanation: {川|chuān} is the short name of {四川|Sì chuān}, so {川菜|chuān cài} is Sichuan cooking. Cantonese is {粤菜|yuè cài} and Shandong {鲁菜|lǔ cài}.

questions.stem: Which feeling does {麻|má} describe?
questions.explanation: {麻|má} is the tingling numbness of Sichuan pepper. With chilli heat ({辣|là}) it makes {麻辣|má là}, the signature of Sichuan cooking. Sweet is {甜|tián} and sour {酸|suān}.

questions.stem: Which of these is NOT one of the "four great cuisines"?
questions.explanation: The four are Sichuan ({川菜|chuān cài}), Shandong ({鲁菜|lǔ cài}), Cantonese ({粤菜|yuè cài}) and Huaiyang ({淮扬菜|huái yáng cài}). Beijing's cooking, roast duck and all, isn't in the four or the usual eight: the groupings leave out many well-loved styles.

questions.stem: How are the "eight great cuisines" of China best described?
choices: an official list set by law
a common modern grouping, not the whole picture
the only eight cuisines in China
questions.explanation: The eight extend the older four and are a common way of grouping regional cooking. They're not a rule, and many other styles (Beijing's, Yunnan's and more) are left out.

questions.stem: What is {点心|diǎn xin}?
choices: dim sum: small Cantonese dishes such as steamed shrimp dumplings
questions.explanation: {点心|diǎn xin} is dim sum ("dim sum" is the Cantonese pronunciation of the same characters), eaten with tea, which is why a dim sum meal is often called {喝|hē}{早茶|zǎo chá} in Guangdong.

questions.stem: Five friends go out for dinner. How do they usually order?
choices: Each person orders a main course for themselves.
They order dishes to share, often about one per person and one more.
They order one big dish for everyone.
questions.explanation: Dishes go in the middle and everyone takes a little of each, with their own bowl of rice. A common rule of thumb: {五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{点|diǎn}{六七|liù qī}{个|gè}{菜|cài}.

questions.stem: What are {公筷|gōng kuài}?
choices: serving chopsticks, used only to take food from shared dishes
questions.explanation: {公筷|gōng kuài}, "public chopsticks", are used only for serving from the shared dishes. You eat with your own pair.

questions.stem: Read the menu: "{麻婆豆腐|má pó dòu fu}　{很|hěn}{辣|là}　28{元|yuán} / {宫保鸡丁|gōng bǎo jī dīng}　{辣|là}　38{元|yuán} / {青菜|qīng cài}　18{元|yuán}" You can't eat spicy food. What can you order?
questions.explanation: Only {青菜|qīng cài} (green vegetables) has no {辣|là} mark. {麻婆豆腐|má pó dòu fu} is {很|hěn}{辣|là}, and {宫保鸡丁|gōng bǎo jī dīng} is {辣|là} too.

questions.stem: Read the menu again: "{麻婆豆腐|má pó dòu fu}　{很|hěn}{辣|là}　28{元|yuán} / {宫保鸡丁|gōng bǎo jī dīng}　{辣|là}　38{元|yuán} / {青菜|qīng cài}　18{元|yuán}" Your friend orders the mapo tofu and the kung pao chicken. About how much is it?
questions.explanation: 28 + 38 = 66, so {六十多|liù shí duō}{块|kuài}, sixty-odd kuai: {多|duō} after the round number, before the measure word.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the customer asking for?
questions.explanation: You heard {别|bié}{放|fàng}{辣|là}，{谢谢|xiè xie}！: "Don't put in chilli, thanks": no chilli. {放|fàng} (to put in) is an HSK 3 word.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker suggest?

audio.text: 我们五个人，点六七个菜吧。

choices: Six people should order seven dishes.
Five dishes are enough for seven people.
Five of them should order six or seven dishes.
questions.explanation: You heard {我们|wǒ men}{五|wǔ}{个|gè}{人|rén}，{点|diǎn}{六七|liù qī}{个|gè}{菜|cài}{吧|ba}: "there are five of us; let's order six or seven dishes". {六七|liù qī} is two neighbouring numbers, an approximate number.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker asking?
questions.explanation: You heard {这个|zhè ge}{菜|cài}{辣|là}{不|bu}{辣|là}？, an A-not-A question: is this dish spicy or not?

questions.stem: Which description fits Cantonese cooking ({粤菜|yuè cài}) best?
choices: whole carp in sweet and sour sauce
light sauces that let fresh ingredients taste of themselves
questions.explanation: {粤菜|yuè cài} is known for light sauces and fresh ingredients, and for dim sum. Hot and numbing is Sichuan; sweet and sour carp is a Shandong dish; roast duck is Beijing's.

questions.stem: When is the Mid-Autumn Festival?
choices: on the 15th day of the 8th month of the lunar calendar
on 15 August in the Gregorian calendar
on the first full moon of the year
on the 8th day of the 15th month
questions.explanation: {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié} is on {八|bā}{月|yuè}{十五|shí wǔ} of the traditional calendar, the night of the full moon. In the Gregorian calendar it moves, landing in September or early October. The first full moon of the year is the Lantern Festival.

questions.stem: What does {中秋|zhōng qiū} in {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié} mean?
questions.explanation: {中|zhōng} is "middle" and {秋|qiū} "autumn": the festival falls in the middle of the three autumn months of the traditional calendar. {节|jié} is "festival".

questions.stem: Why is the full moon a symbol of family on this night?
choices: It is the brightest moon of the year by law.
A round, full moon stands for a family that is whole and together.
The moon is the family's oldest member.
questions.explanation: Round means whole: the full moon and the round mooncakes stand for {团圆|tuán yuán}, the family together. That's why people try to go home for the festival.

questions.stem: In the best-known version of the Mid-Autumn legend, what does Chang'e ({嫦娥|Cháng'é}) do?
choices: She plants a tree on the moon.
She takes the medicine of immortality and flies to the moon.
questions.explanation: Chang'e ({嫦娥|Cháng'é}) takes the medicine herself so that a bad man can't steal it, and flies to the moon. It's her husband, {后羿|Hòu Yì}, who shoots down nine of the ten suns. Versions of the story differ on why she takes it.

questions.stem: Who wrote 《{静夜思|jìng yè sī}》 ("Quiet Night Thoughts"), and when?
choices: Li Bai, in the Tang dynasty
Li Bai, in the Qing dynasty
an unknown poet of the Song dynasty
questions.explanation: {李白|Lǐ Bái} was one of the great poets of the Tang dynasty (618–907). The Qing dynasty is when the popular anthology 《{唐诗三百首|Táng shī sān bǎi shǒu}》, with the familiar wording of the poem, was put together.

questions.stem: Complete the last line of the poem: {举头望明月|jǔ tóu wàng míng yuè}，{低头|dī tóu} ___ 。
questions.explanation: {低头思故乡|dī tóu sī gù xiāng}: "I bow my head and think of home." The poem moves from looking up at the moon to looking down, lost in thought about home.

questions.stem: What does the line {疑是地上霜|yí shì dì shàng shuāng} mean?
choices: I wonder: is it frost on the ground?
The ground is wet with rain.
There is snow on the mountain.
I lie down on the cold ground.
questions.explanation: {疑|yí} is "to suspect, to wonder", and {地上霜|dì shàng shuāng} is "frost on the ground": the moonlight on the floor is so white that it looks like frost.

questions.stem: Older texts of the poem (for example in the Song-dynasty anthology 《{乐府诗集|Yuè fǔ shī jí}》) have a different third line. Which?
choices: {低头望明月|dī tóu wàng míng yuè}
{床前明月光|chuáng qián míng yuè guāng}
{举头看月光|jǔ tóu kàn yuè guāng}
{举头望山月|jǔ tóu wàng shān yuè}
questions.explanation: The older texts read {举头望山月|jǔ tóu wàng shān yuè} ("I gaze at the mountain moon") and, in the first line, {床前看月光|chuáng qián kàn yuè guāng}. The familiar {明月|míng yuè} wording is the one in popular Qing anthologies.

questions.stem: Read: "{妈妈|mā ma}，{中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{快乐|kuài lè}！{我|wǒ}{今年|jīn nián}{不|bù}{能|néng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{过|guò}{节|jié}。{我们|wǒ men}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{月饼|yuè bǐng}。{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{很|hěn}{晴|qíng}，{月亮|yuè liang}{这么|zhè me}{大|dà}！" Where is the writer spending the festival?
choices: at school with a few classmates
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{和|hé}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{过|guò}{节|jié}: with a few classmates, at school. {不|bù}{能|néng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}: they can't go home this year.

questions.stem: Read the message again: "{妈妈|mā ma}，{中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{快乐|kuài lè}！{我|wǒ}{今年|jīn nián}{不|bù}{能|néng}{回|huí}{家|jiā}，{我|wǒ}{和|hé}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{过|guò}{节|jié}。{我们|wǒ men}{买|mǎi}{了|le}{十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{月饼|yuè bǐng}。{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{很|hěn}{晴|qíng}，{月亮|yuè liang}{这么|zhè me}{大|dà}！" How many mooncakes did they buy?
questions.explanation: {十几|shí jǐ}{个|gè}{月饼|yuè bǐng}: between eleven and nineteen, a dozen or so. "Dozens" would be {几十|jǐ shí}{个|gè}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is the speaker saying?
questions.explanation: You heard {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{快乐|kuài lè}！ The festival's name + {快乐|kuài lè} makes the greeting, like {生日快乐|shēng rì kuài lè}.

questions.stem: Listen. What do you learn about the festival?
choices: It is on the fifteenth of the eighth month.
It is eight days from now.
It is on the eighth of the fifth month.
questions.explanation: You heard {中秋节|Zhōng qiū jié}{是|shì}{八|bā}{月|yuè}{十五|shí wǔ}: the fifteenth day of the eighth month (of the traditional calendar), the night of the full moon.

questions.stem: Listen. Which poem is this the beginning of?

audio.text: 床前明月光，疑是地上霜。

questions.explanation: You heard the first two lines of 《{静夜思|jìng yè sī}》: {床前明月光|chuáng qián míng yuè guāng}，{疑是地上霜|yí shì dì shàng shuāng}。

questions.stem: Which sentence means "It's about to rain."?
questions.explanation: {快要|kuài yào} + verb + {了|le} is "about to": {快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。 The {了|le} belongs to the pattern, so {快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ} sounds unfinished. {已经|yǐ jīng}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le} says it has started raining, and {还|hái}{没|méi}{下雨|xià yǔ}{呢|ne} that it hasn't rained yet.

questions.stem: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}___ {考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}。 Choose the word for the blank (We have our exam tomorrow).
questions.explanation: With a time word such as {明天|míng tiān}, "about to" is {就|jiù}{要|yào}……{了|le}: {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}。 {快要|kuài yào} already means "very soon" and doesn't go with a time word, {已经|yǐ jīng} would say the exam is over, and {还|hái} is "still".

questions.stem: ___ {十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}。 Choose the word for the blank (It's nearly ten o'clock).
questions.explanation: Before a time or a number, "nearly" is usually {快|kuài}: {快|kuài}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}。 {已经|yǐ jīng}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le} says it's already ten, {就|jiù}{要|yào} goes before a verb ({明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}), and {正在|zhèng zài} marks something happening now.

questions.stem: Which sentence means "I haven't eaten yet."?
questions.explanation: "Not yet" is {还|hái}{没|méi} + verb, often with {呢|ne} and never with {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{呢|ne}。 Nothing has happened, so there's no {了|le} for a completed action or a change. {已经|yǐ jīng}{没|méi} isn't used for "not yet", and {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le} means "I'm not going to eat (after all)".

questions.stem: Someone says “{都|dōu}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}！” What do they mean?
choices: It's ten o'clock already, and that's late.
They are all ten years old.
It was ten o'clock a moment ago.
questions.explanation: {都|dōu} + time + {了|le} is "already!", with the feeling that it's late or a lot: {都|dōu}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}！ "Nearly ten" would be {快|kuài}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le}. "All ten years old" would need {岁|suì} ({他们|tā men}{都|dōu}{十|shí}{岁|suì}).

questions.stem: “{外面|wài miàn}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{我们|wǒ men}{还是|hái shi}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{吧|ba}。” What is the speaker doing?
choices: suggesting the metro as the better choice
asking whether to walk or take the metro
saying they are still on the metro
saying the metro has already left
questions.explanation: {还是|hái shi} + verb + {吧|ba} is a suggestion after weighing the choices: "It's raining outside; we'd better take the metro." {还是|hái shi} is "or" only in a question ({咖啡|kā fēi}{还是|hái shi}{茶|chá}？), and "still" without the {吧|ba}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is happening?
choices: The film is about to start.
questions.explanation: The speaker said {电影|diàn yǐng}{快要|kuài yào}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}。 — The film is about to start. "Has already started" would be {已经|yǐ jīng}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le}, and "starts tomorrow" {明天|míng tiān}{开始|kāi shǐ}.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker think?

audio.text: 都十二点了，你怎么还没睡觉？

choices: The listener is sleeping too much.
It's late, and the listener should be asleep.
questions.explanation: {都|dōu}{十二|shí èr}{点|diǎn}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{还|hái}{没|méi}{睡觉|shuì jiào}？ — It's already twelve! Why aren't you asleep yet? {都|dōu}……{了|le} says it's late, and {还|hái}{没|méi} + verb says the listener hasn't gone to bed yet.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. You haven't eaten yet. Which reply fits?
questions.explanation: The question was {你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ (Have you eaten?). The short answer "not yet" is {还|hái}{没|méi}{呢|ne}。, without {了|le}. {还是|hái shi}{吧|ba} isn't an answer to a question about the past.

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker say?
choices: They are on the phone now.
They were just about to call the listener.
They have already called the listener.
questions.explanation: {正|zhèng}{要|yào} + verb is "just about to": {我|wǒ}{正|zhèng}{要|yào}{给|gěi}{你|nǐ}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}！ — I was just going to call you! "On the phone now" would be {我|wǒ}{正在|zhèng zài}{打电话|dǎ diàn huà}{呢|ne}.

questions.stem: Which is the pinyin of 还是 in 我们还是走吧 (we'd better go)?
questions.explanation: {还是|hái shi} is hái shi, with {是|shì} light (neutral tone). {还|hái} is read hái here, as in {还|hái}{没|méi}; huán is another word (to give back) that you'll meet in HSK 3. sì with an s would be {四|sì}.

questions.stem: Match each pattern to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {已经|yǐ jīng}……{了|le} already done, {快要|kuài yào}……{了|le} about to happen, {还|hái}{没|méi}……{呢|ne} not yet, {都|dōu}……{了|le} "already!" with a feeling that it's late, {还是|hái shi}……{吧|ba} a suggestion. "Still doing it" would be {还|hái}{在|zài} + verb ({他|tā}{还|hái}{在|zài}{睡觉|shuì jiào}).

questions.stem: Which character completes the word 已___ (already)?
questions.explanation: {已经|yǐ jīng} is written with {经|jīng}, which you know from {经常|jīng cháng} (often). All four have the silk radical 纟 on the left: {红|hóng} is in {红色|hóng sè} (red), {给|gěi} is "to give", and {绿|lǜ} is in {绿色|lǜ sè} (green).

questions.stem: Which character makes the word "already": ___ {经|jīng}
questions.explanation: {已|yǐ} (already) has a short stroke that closes the top-left corner halfway. {己|jǐ} (self, in {自己|zì jǐ}) leaves that corner open. {包|bāo} (bag) and {色|sè} (colour) have a similar shape at the bottom, but more strokes on top.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
choices: {明天|míng tiān}{快要|kuài yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}。
{明天|míng tiān}{已经|yǐ jīng}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}。
questions.explanation: {快|kuài}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}{了|le} (it's nearly ten) is right: before a time or a number, {快|kuài} is the usual word. {已经|yǐ jīng} is for what has happened, so it can't go with {明天|míng tiān}. With a time word, "about to" is {就|jiù}{要|yào}: {明天|míng tiān}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{考试|kǎo shì}{了|le}. "Not yet" never takes {了|le}: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{呢|ne}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: We'd better take a taxi.
questions.explanation: {还是|hái shi} + verb + {吧|ba} makes the suggestion: {我们|wǒ men}{还是|hái shi}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba}。 {还是|hái shi} goes after the subject and before the verb, and the sentence ends with {吧|ba}, not {了|le}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: He's nearly twenty.
questions.explanation: Before an age or a number, "nearly" is {快|kuài} + number + {了|le}: {他|tā}{快|kuài}{二十|èr shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}。 {已经|yǐ jīng} would say he is already twenty, which doesn't go with {快|kuài}.

choices: Xiao Wang is already at the station.
Anna is waiting at the station.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{到|dào}{车站|chē zhàn}{了|le} — Anna is already at the station, and {你|nǐ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{出门|chū mén}{吗|ma}？ asks whether Xiao Wang hasn't left home yet. {七|qī}{点|diǎn}{就|jiù}{要|yào}{开始|kāi shǐ}{了|le} says the film starts at seven: it hasn't started.

questions.stem:
Read the conversation.

A：{你|nǐ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{吗|ma}？{我们|wǒ men}{快要|kuài yào}{走|zǒu}{了|le}。 B：{还|hái}{没|méi}{呢|ne}，{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{在|zài}{洗|xǐ}{衣服|yī fu}。{等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一会儿|yí huìr}！

What is B doing?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{在|zài}{洗|xǐ}{衣服|yī fu} — I'm still washing clothes. {还|hái}{没|méi}{呢|ne} answers "not yet" to {你|nǐ}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{了|le}{吗|ma}？, and {等|děng}{我|wǒ}{一会儿|yí huìr} asks A to wait a moment.

questions.stem: A friend messages you: {你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}{吗|ma}？ You haven't eaten yet. Type the short reply in characters (or pinyin with tones): ___
questions.explanation: {还|hái}{没|méi}{呢|ne} (not yet) is the usual short answer; {还|hái}{没|méi} alone is fine too. No {了|le}: the action hasn't happened. To type characters you need a Chinese keyboard on your device (choose them from the pinyin hái méi ne); pinyin with tones is accepted too.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {已经|yǐ jīng}, already: a low third tone, then a high level first tone (3+1), as in {我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{吃|chī}{饭|fàn}{了|le}。

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {下雨|xià yǔ}, to rain: a falling fourth tone, then a low third tone (4+3), as in {快要|kuài yào}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}。

questions.stem:
Read the notice.

{通知|tōng zhī}：{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}，{高中|gāo zhōng}{二|èr}{班|bān}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{郭老师|Guō lǎo shī}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{坐|zuò}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{去|qù}{北京大学|Běi jīng Dà xué}。{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{回来|huí lái}。{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{水|shuǐ}。

Where do the students meet?
choices: in a classroom on the second floor
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{郭老师|Guō lǎo shī} — wait for Teacher Guo at the school gate. {北京大学|Běi jīng Dà xué} (Peking University) is where they're going, by bus, and {二|èr}{班|bān} is the class (Class 2), not a floor.

questions.stem:
Read the notice.

{通知|tōng zhī}：{这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{六|liù}{上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn}，{高中|gāo zhōng}{二|èr}{班|bān}{的|de}{同学|tóng xué}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{郭老师|Guō lǎo shī}，{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{坐|zuò}{公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{去|qù}{北京大学|Běi jīng Dà xué}。{下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{回来|huí lái}。{请|qǐng}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{水|shuǐ}。

When will the class be back?
questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn}{回来|huí lái} — back at four in the afternoon. {上午|shàng wǔ}{九|jiǔ}{点|diǎn} is when they leave. Scan for {点|diǎn} and the words for parts of the day ({上午|shàng wǔ}, {下午|xià wǔ}) to find times quickly.

questions.stem:
Read the notice on a pharmacy door.

{药店|yào diàn}{时间|shí jiān}
{每|měi}{天|tiān}：8:00—22:00
1{月|yuè}1{日|rì}：10:00—16:00

You need medicine at 9 p.m. on 1 January. What happens?
choices: {'The pharmacy is closed': 'on 1 January it closes at 4 p.m.'}
The pharmacy is closed every evening.
questions.explanation: On ordinary days the pharmacy is open 8:00—22:00, but 1{月|yuè}1{日|rì} has its own line: 10:00—16:00, so at 21:00 it's closed. Read every line of a notice: the special day is usually the last.

questions.stem:
Read the message.

{爸爸|bà ba}：{我|wǒ}{已经|yǐ jīng}{下课|xià kè}{了|le}，{现在|xiàn zài}{在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{门口|mén kǒu}。{外面|wài miàn}{下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}，{你|nǐ}{能|néng}{开车|kāi chē}{来|lái}{学校|xué xiào}{吗|ma}？

What does the writer want?
choices: to stay at school after class
Dad to come to the school by car
Dad to bring an umbrella to the classroom
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{能|néng}{开车|kāi chē}{来|lái}{学校|xué xiào}{吗|ma}？ — Can you drive to the school? The writer has finished class ({已经|yǐ jīng}{下课|xià kè}{了|le}), is waiting at the gate, and it's raining ({下雨|xià yǔ}{了|le}).

questions.stem:
Read the chat.

{王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{明天|míng tiān}{的|de}{考试|kǎo shì}{是|shì}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}？ {李明|Lǐ Míng}：{上午|shàng wǔ}{十|shí}{点|diǎn}，{在|zài}205{教室|jiào shì}。 {王芳|Wáng Fāng}：{谢谢|xiè xie}！{我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{呢|ne}。 {李明|Lǐ Míng}：{我|wǒ}{也|yě}{没|méi}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}。{今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{学习|xué xí}{吧|ba}！

Which is true?
choices: Wang Fang is ready for the exam.
Li Ming doesn't know where the exam is.
Neither of them is ready, so they'll study together tonight.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{还|hái}{没|méi}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{呢|ne} (I'm not ready yet) and {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{没|méi}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo} (I'm not ready either), then {今天|jīn tiān}{晚上|wǎn shang}{我们|wǒ men}{一起|yì qǐ}{学习|xué xí}{吧|ba} (let's study together this evening). The exam is tomorrow at ten in room 205.

questions.stem: A notice says: {请|qǐng}{到|dào}{三|sān}{楼|lóu}。 Where do you go?
questions.explanation: {楼|lóu} after a number is the floor: {三|sān}{楼|lóu} is the third floor (no {第|dì} needed). Room 3 would be 3{号|hào} or {三|sān}{号|hào}{房间|fáng jiān}, and three o'clock {三|sān}{点|diǎn}.

Chinese names put the surname first: {张小雨|Zhāng Xiǎo yǔ} is Zhang Xiaoyu, with the surname {张|Zhāng} (Zhang) and the given name {小雨|Xiǎo yǔ}. On a form, {姓名|xìng míng} asks for the full name, in that order.
Dates go from big to small: year, month, day. 2009{年|nián}10{月|yuè}3{日|rì} is 3 October 2009. Forms write the day with {日|rì}; in speech you'd say {十|shí}{月|yuè}{三|sān}{号|hào}.

questions.stem:
Read the timetable (real train numbers, made-up times).

{车次|chē cì}　{上海|Shàng hǎi} {开|kāi}　{北京|Běi jīng} {到|dào}
G102　08:00　12:30
G104　09:00　14:10
G106　11:00　15:20

Which train takes the longest?
choices: They all take the same time.
questions.explanation: G102 takes 4 hours 30 minutes (8:00 to 12:30), G104 5 hours 10 minutes (9:00 to 14:10) and G106 4 hours 20 minutes. {开|kāi} is when the train leaves Shanghai, {到|dào} when it arrives in Beijing.
One fish is 68 and two rice are 2 × 3 = 6: 74 yuan, said {七十四|qī shí sì}{块|kuài}. 71 counts only one rice; 116 adds the meat dish too.

questions.stem: A question asks what time a shop opens. What is the fastest way to find the answer in its notice?
choices: Scan the notice for numbers and words such as {点|diǎn} and {上午|shàng wǔ}.
Read every word slowly from the beginning.
Look for the shop's phone number.
questions.explanation: Looking for one fact without reading everything is scanning: times show up as numbers with {点|diǎn}, {上午|shàng wǔ} / {下午|xià wǔ} or the 24-hour clock (9:00). Then read the sentence around what you found, to catch a {不|bù} or a special day.

questions.stem: The notice on a shop door says: {星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{休息|xiū xi}. What does it mean?
choices: The shop is closed on Mondays.
There are places to sit down on Mondays.
questions.explanation: {休息|xiū xi} (to rest) on a shop, a museum or a restaurant notice means "closed": {星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{休息|xiū xi} is "closed on Mondays".

questions.stem: Match each word on a notice or ticket to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {通知|tōng zhī} notice, {休息|xiū xi} closed (on a shop or office), {开学|kāi xué} the start of the school term, {门票|mén piào} admission ticket ({门|mén} + {票|piào}), {车次|chē cì} train number. "Exit" is {出|chū}{口|kǒu}.

questions.stem: Listen. When does the pharmacy open?
questions.explanation: {药店|yào diàn}{早上|zǎo shang}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{开门|kāi mén}。 — The pharmacy opens at eight in the morning. {开门|kāi mén} (to open, literally "open the door") is {开|kāi} + {门|mén}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where should everyone wait?

audio.text: 请大家在教室门口等我。

questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{在|zài}{教室|jiào shì}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{我|wǒ}。 — Please wait for me at the classroom door, everyone. {门口|mén kǒu} is the doorway or entrance; inside would be {教室|jiào shì}{里面|lǐ miàn}, next to {教室|jiào shì}{旁边|páng biān}.

questions.stem: Listen. How far is the metro station?

audio.text: 地铁站离这儿不远，往前走五分钟就到了。

questions.explanation: {地铁|dì tiě}{站|zhàn}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{不|bù}{远|yuǎn}，{往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}{五|wǔ}{分钟|fēn zhōng}{就|jiù}{到|dào}{了|le}。 — The metro station isn't far from here: go straight ahead for five minutes and you're there. {往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu} is "walk forward"; to the left would be {往|wǎng}{左|zuǒ}{走|zǒu}.

questions.stem: Which is the pinyin of 商场 (shopping centre)?
questions.explanation: {商场|shāng chǎng} is shāng chǎng: {商|shāng} as in {商店|shāng diàn} (first tone), {场|chǎng} as in {机场|jī chǎng} (third tone). Don't confuse chǎng with cháng (long, {长|cháng}).

questions.stem: A sign at a park says: {门|mén}___ 20{元|yuán} (admission ticket 20 yuan). Which character completes it?
questions.explanation: {门票|mén piào} (admission ticket) is {门|mén} + {票|piào} (ticket), as in {机票|jī piào} (plane ticket). {票|piào}, {要|yào} and {西|xī} share the same top part; {要|yào} has {女|nǚ} underneath and {票|piào} has 示.

questions.stem: Build the sentence for a notice. {带|dài} is "to bring".
questions.prompt: Please don't forget to bring your notebook.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng} + {别|bié} + verb is a polite "please don't": {请|qǐng}{别|bié}{忘|wàng}{了|le}{带|dài}{本子|běn zi}。 {别|bié} goes straight before the verb ({忘|wàng}{了|le}), and {带|dài}{本子|běn zi} (bring a notebook) says what not to forget. {没|méi} is for the past, not for requests.

questions.stem: Read the notice: {请|qǐng}{大家|dà jiā}{明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}302{教室|jiào shì}。 Type in characters (or pinyin with tones) the time to be there (the part with {点|diǎn}): ___
questions.explanation: The time is {上午|shàng wǔ}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}, eight in the morning: {上午|shàng wǔ} (morning) comes before the hour, big to small. {八|bā}{点|diǎn} alone is fine too. Type it with a Chinese keyboard on your device, or as pinyin with tones (bā diǎn).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {开学|kāi xué}, school starts: a high level first tone, then a rising second tone (1+2), as in the notice {下|xià}{星期|xīng qī}{一|yī}{开学|kāi xué}。

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {旁边|páng biān}, next to: a rising second tone, then a high level first tone (2+1). In {左边|zuǒ bian} and {右边|yòu bian} the second syllable is usually light, but in {旁边|páng biān} it keeps its tone.

questions.stem: Listen. How did the speaker come?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{是|shì}{坐|zuò}{地铁|dì tiě}{来|lái}{的|de}。 — I came by metro. {是|shì}……{的|de} tells how a past event happened. A taxi would be {打车|dǎ chē}, a bus {公交车|gōng jiāo chē}, on foot {走路|zǒu lù}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where will they meet?

audio.text: 我们三点在电影院门口见吧。

questions.explanation: {我们|wǒ men}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{电影院|diàn yǐng yuàn}{门口|mén kǒu}{见|jiàn}{吧|ba}。 — Let's meet at the cinema entrance at three. {门口|mén kǒu} is the doorway or entrance; inside would be {里面|lǐ miàn}, next to {旁边|páng biān}.

questions.stem: Listen. How much is it?
questions.explanation: {两百八十|liǎng bǎi bā shí}{块|kuài} is 280 yuan: {两百|liǎng bǎi} (200) + {八十|bā shí} (80). 208 would be {两百零八|liǎng bǎi líng bā} (with {零|líng} for the empty tens), and 2,800 {两千八|liǎng qiān bā}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which phone number is it?

audio.text: 我的手机号是一二八，零零零零，一二三四。

questions.explanation: The number is 128 0000 1234, read digit by digit. People say 1 as yāo in phone numbers (yāo èr bā…); a computer voice may say yī.

questions.stem: Listen to the two speakers. When is the second speaker going to Beijing?

audio.text: 你什么时候去北京？下个星期四。

questions.explanation: {下|xià}{个|gè}{星期|xīng qī}{四|sì} is next Thursday: {下|xià}{个|gè} (next) + {星期|xīng qī}{四|sì} (Thursday). This Thursday would be {这个|zhè ge}{星期|xīng qī}{四|sì}, and the 4th {四|sì}{号|hào}.

questions.stem: Listen to the two speakers. How will they go?

audio.text: 我们坐公交车去吧。公交车太慢了，我们还是打车吧。

questions.explanation: The first speaker suggests the bus, but the second says it's too slow ({公交车|gōng jiāo chē}{太|tài}{慢|màn}{了|le}) and suggests a taxi: {我们|wǒ men}{还是|hái shi}{打车|dǎ chē}{吧|ba}. Listen to the end: the plan often changes in the reply.

questions.stem: Listen. How old is the father?

audio.text: 他十四岁，他爸爸四十岁。

questions.explanation: {他|tā}{十四|shí sì}{岁|suì} (he is 14), {他|tā}{爸爸|bà ba}{四十|sì shí}{岁|suì} (his father is 40). In {十四|shí sì} the {十|shí} comes first (ten + four); in {四十|sì shí} the {四|sì} comes first (four tens).

questions.stem: Listen. What does the speaker want?

audio.text: 对不起，我没听懂，请再说一下。

choices: the listener to say it again
the listener to speak more loudly
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng} (I didn't understand), {请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià} (please say it again). "More slowly" would be {请|qǐng}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō}.

questions.stem: Listen. Where is the pharmacy?

audio.text: 药店离这儿很近，就在商场旁边。

choices: far away, next to the shopping centre
close by, next to the shopping centre
close by, behind the shopping centre
questions.explanation: {药店|yào diàn}{离|lí}{这儿|zhèr}{很|hěn}{近|jìn} (the pharmacy is very close to here), {就|jiù}{在|zài}{商场|shāng chǎng}{旁边|páng biān} (right next to the shopping centre). {近|jìn} is near; far would be {远|yuǎn}. Behind would be {后面|hòu miàn}.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which reply fits?
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}？ asks how (by what means) you're going to the airport: {打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù} (by taxi). {机场|jī chǎng}{很|hěn}{大|dà} would answer {机场|jī chǎng}{怎么样|zěn me yàng}？, {明天|míng tiān}{上午|shàng wǔ} {什么|shén me}{时候|shí hou}, and {和|hé}{我|wǒ}{妈妈|mā ma} {跟|gēn}{谁|shéi}.

questions.stem: Listen to the question. Which reply fits?

audio.text: 这个周末你想看电影还是去游泳？

questions.explanation: A {还是|hái shi} B asks you to choose one: "Do you want to see a film or go swimming this weekend?" The answer names one of them: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{游泳|yóu yǒng}。 {是|shì} and {不错|bú cuò} don't choose.

questions.stem: Listen. What does Teacher Wang want?

audio.text: 王老师让我们明天八点到学校。

choices: to come to the school at eight tomorrow
the students to be at school at eight tomorrow
the students to stay at home tomorrow
the students to call at eight
questions.explanation: {让|ràng} + person + verb: {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī}{让|ràng}{我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān}{八|bā}{点|diǎn}{到|dào}{学校|xué xiào} — Teacher Wang wants us (has us) at school at eight tomorrow. The teacher isn't coming: {我们|wǒ men} are the ones who arrive.

questions.stem: “{你|nǐ}___ {去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}？” “{打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}。” Choose the question word.
questions.explanation: {怎么|zěn me} + verb asks how, by what means: {你|nǐ}{怎么|zěn me}{去|qù}{机场|jī chǎng}？ — {打车|dǎ chē}{去|qù}. {怎么样|zěn me yàng} asks what something is like, {为什么|wèi shén me} why, and {什么|shén me}{时候|shí hou} when.

questions.stem: {他|tā}{家|jiā}{离|lí}{学校|xué xiào}{很|hěn}___。 (His home is close to the school.) Which character, said jìn, is right here?
questions.explanation: {近|jìn} (near) and {进|jìn} (to enter) are both jìn, with the same tone: only the context tells them apart in speech. Here it's distance: {离|lí}{学校|xué xiào}{很|hěn}{近|jìn}. {远|yuǎn} is the opposite, far.

questions.stem: Which is the pinyin of 卖 (to sell)?
questions.explanation: {卖|mài} (to sell) is mài, fourth tone; {买|mǎi} (to buy) is mǎi, third tone. In listening, the tone is the only difference: {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{卖|mài}{车|chē} and {我|wǒ}{想|xiǎng}{买|mǎi}{车|chē} are opposites.

questions.stem: Someone says the price is {两万五|liǎng wàn wǔ}. How much is it?
questions.explanation: {两万五|liǎng wàn wǔ} is short for {两万五千|liǎng wàn wǔ qiān}: 2 × 10,000 + 5,000 = 25,000. The last unit ({千|qiān}) is understood. 2,500 would be {两千五|liǎng qiān wǔ}.

questions.stem: You hear {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}. How many people is that?
questions.explanation: {十|shí}{几|jǐ} is "ten-odd", a number between 11 and 19: {十|shí}{几|jǐ}{个|gè}{人|rén}. Several dozen would be {几|jǐ}{十|shí}{个|gè}{人|rén}, with {几|jǐ} before {十|shí}.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: Please speak a little more slowly.
questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō}。 — the adjective with {一点儿|yì diǎnr} goes before the verb: {慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō} (speak a bit slower). {请|qǐng}{说|shuō}{慢|màn}{一点儿|yì diǎnr} is just as common. {快|kuài}{一点儿|yì diǎnr}{说|shuō} would be "speak faster".

questions.stem: Match each phrase to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng} I didn't understand (what you said), {请|qǐng}{再|zài}{说|shuō}{一下|yí xià} please say it again, {你|nǐ}{说|shuō}{什么|shén me}？ what did you say?, {是|shì}{吗|ma}？ really?, {我|wǒ}{也|yě}{是|shì} me too. "I don't know" is {我|wǒ}{不|bù}{知道|zhī dào}.

questions.stem: A friend asks: {我们|wǒ men}{几|jǐ}{点|diǎn}{见|jiàn}？ You want to meet at half past three. Type the time in characters (or pinyin with tones): ___
questions.explanation: Half past three is {三|sān}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}: the hour with {点|diǎn}, then {半|bàn} (half). Add {下午|xià wǔ} in front if you like: {下午|xià wǔ}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{半|bàn}. Type it with a Chinese keyboard, or as pinyin with tones (sān diǎn bàn).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {右|yòu}, right (the side): the fourth tone, falling. {有|yǒu} (to have) is the same syllable with the third tone.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {懂|dǒng}, to understand: the third tone, low, as in {我|wǒ}{没|méi}{听|tīng}{懂|dǒng}。

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {万|wàn}, ten thousand: the fourth tone, falling, as in {两万五|liǎng wàn wǔ}.

questions.stem: Wang Fang (surname {王|Wáng}) fills in {姓名|xìng míng} on a form. What does she write?
questions.explanation: {姓名|xìng míng} is the full name, surname first: {王芳|Wáng Fāng}. {芳王|Fāng Wáng} is the English order, {王老师|Wáng lǎo shī} a title, and {小芳|Xiǎo Fāng} a friendly nickname, not for forms.

questions.stem: How do you write 16 May 2008 on a Chinese form?
questions.explanation: Dates go from big to small: year, month, day, each with its unit: 2008{年|nián}5{月|yuè}16{日|rì}. Forms use {日|rì} for the day; in speech it's {号|hào}.

questions.stem: Which address is in the right Chinese order?
choices: 3{楼|lóu}15{号|hào}{大明|Dà míng}{路|lù}{北京市|Běi jīng shì}
{大明|Dà míng}{路|lù}{北京市|Běi jīng shì}15{号|hào}3{楼|lóu}
{北京市|Běi jīng shì}{大明|Dà míng}{路|lù}15{号|hào}3{楼|lóu}
15{号|hào}3{楼|lóu}{北京市|Běi jīng shì}{大明|Dà míng}{路|lù}
questions.explanation: Chinese addresses go from big to small: the city ({北京市|Běi jīng shì}), the road ({大明|Dà míng}{路|lù}), the number (15{号|hào}), then the floor (3{楼|lóu}). English goes the other way, starting with the room or house.

questions.stem: How do you write "two books"?
questions.explanation: Number + measure word + noun: {两|liǎng}{本|běn}{书|shū}. Before a measure word, "two" is {两|liǎng}, not {二|èr}, and the measure word {本|běn} can't be left out.

questions.stem: How do you write "three cups of coffee"?
questions.explanation: The cup is the measure word: {三|sān}{杯|bēi}{咖啡|kā fēi} (three cups of coffee). {杯|bēi} replaces {个|gè}; you don't use both. Without a measure word, {三|sān}{咖啡|kā fēi} isn't Chinese.

questions.stem: What do you write on a friend's birthday card?
questions.explanation: {生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè}！ — Happy birthday! {新年|xīn nián}{快乐|kuài lè} is Happy New Year, {明天|míng tiān}{见|jiàn} see you tomorrow, and {不好意思|bù hǎo yì si} an apology ("sorry, excuse me").

choices: Mum has gone to the pharmacy.
Xiaoming will be back at four.
questions.explanation: The note is from {小明|Xiǎo Míng} to {妈妈|mā ma}: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{药店|yào diàn}{买|mǎi}{药|yào}{了|le} (I've gone to the pharmacy to buy medicine), {一会儿|yí huìr}{回来|huí lái} (back in a little while). {下午|xià wǔ}{四|sì}{点|diǎn} is when he wrote it.

{身体|shēn tǐ}{不|bù}{舒服|shū fu} — he isn't feeling well (literally "body not comfortable"). {不|bù}{能|néng}{去|qù}{上课|shàng kè}{了|le} says he can't come to class after all: the {了|le} marks the change of plan.

questions.stem: A form has the line {性别|xìng bié}. What do you write there?
questions.explanation: {性别|xìng bié} asks for your sex: {男|nán} (male) or {女|nǚ} (female). Nationality is {国籍|guó jí}, date of birth {生日|shēng rì}.

questions.stem: Match each line of a form to its meaning.
questions.explanation: {姓名|xìng míng} full name, {性别|xìng bié} sex, {国籍|guó jí} nationality, {生日|shēng rì} date of birth, {地址|dì zhǐ} address. Hobbies are {爱好|ài hào}.

questions.stem: Which character completes {下|xià}___ (afternoon)?
questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ} is written with {午|wǔ}, whose vertical stroke stops at the top line. In {牛|niú} (as in {牛奶|niú nǎi}, milk) the vertical goes up through it. {年|nián} is "year" and {半|bàn} "half".

questions.stem: Which character completes {丈|zhàng}___ (husband)?
questions.explanation: {夫|fū} (in {丈夫|zhàng fu}) has two horizontal strokes, and the stroke falling to the left starts above the top one and goes through it. In {天|tiān} (sky, day) the top line sits above, not crossed. {大|dà} has one horizontal; {太|tài} is {大|dà} with a dot.

questions.stem: Which character completes {因|yīn}___ (because)?
questions.explanation: {因为|yīn wèi} (because) is written with {为|wèi}, one of the five handwriting characters of HSK 2. {=In simplified characters {头|tóu} (head) has two dots on the left, {关|guān} two dots on top, and {太|tài} one dot below.=}

questions.stem: Which stroke of simplified {={为|wèi}=} do you write first?
choices: the dot at the top left
the horizontal that bends and hooks
questions.explanation: {={为|wèi} has four strokes: the dot at the top left, the long falling stroke, the horizontal that bends down and hooks, and last the dot inside.=} Trace it on the pad in lesson 29 to check (with the switch on Simplified).

questions.stem: You type zai to write {再见|zài jiàn} (goodbye) in a message. Which character do you pick from the list?
questions.explanation: {再见|zài jiàn} is "see you again": {再|zài} (again). {在|zài} (at; in the middle of) has the same sound, zài, so the keyboard offers both: read the character before you send. {菜|cài} is cài, {来|lái} lái.

questions.stem: Listen. What do you need to write?

audio.text: 请写一下你的姓名和手机号。

questions.explanation: {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{一下|yí xià}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{姓名|xìng míng}{和|hé}{手机号|shǒu jī hào}。 — Please write your name and mobile number. {一下|yí xià} makes the request softer.

questions.stem: Listen. When and where will the speaker wait?

audio.text: 我下午三点在药店旁边等你。

choices: at four, next to the pharmacy
at three, at the shopping centre
at three in the afternoon, next to the pharmacy
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{下午|xià wǔ}{三|sān}{点|diǎn}{在|zài}{药店|yào diàn}{旁边|páng biān}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。 — I'll wait for you next to the pharmacy at three in the afternoon. The time comes first, then {在|zài} + place, then the verb.

questions.stem: Build the note in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I'm waiting for you at the door.
questions.explanation: The place with {在|zài} comes before the verb: {我|wǒ}{在|zài}{门口|mén kǒu}{等|děng}{你|nǐ}。 Putting it at the end, English-style, is a common mistake. {往|wǎng} is "towards", for directions ({往|wǎng}{前|qián}{走|zǒu}).

questions.stem: Write in characters (or pinyin with tones): two cups of tea. ___
questions.explanation: Number + measure word + noun: {两|liǎng}{杯|bēi}{茶|chá}. "Two" before a measure word is {两|liǎng}; {杯|bēi} is the measure word for cups. Type it with a Chinese keyboard (liǎng bēi chá).

questions.stem: Write the birthday greeting in characters (four characters), or in pinyin with tones: ___
accept: zhù nǐ shēng rì kuài lè
questions.explanation: {生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè} — happy birthday: {生日|shēng rì} (birthday) + {快乐|kuài lè} (happy). On a card you can also write {祝|zhù}{你|nǐ}{生日|shēng rì}{快乐|kuài lè} (I wish you a happy birthday).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {姓名|xìng míng}, full name (on forms): a falling fourth tone, then a rising second tone (4+2).

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {准备|zhǔn bèi}, to prepare: a low third tone, then a falling fourth tone (3+4), as in {请|qǐng}{准备|zhǔn bèi}{好|hǎo}{本子|běn zi}{和|hé}{笔|bǐ}。

questions.stem: About how many questions does the new HSK 2 (HSK 3.0) have, as reported so far?
questions.explanation: Reports on the sample paper give 60 questions in about 60 minutes for the new HSK 2: 25 listening, 25 reading and 10 writing. About 40 is the new HSK 1. Check chinesetest.cn for the current format before you register.

questions.stem: What do reports on the sample paper of the new HSK 2 describe as new at this level?
questions.explanation: The reports describe a short writing part (choosing a component, writing a character from its pinyin) beside listening and reading; the old HSK 2 had listening and reading only. There's no speaking test at level 2, and no essay or translation.

questions.stem: In a listening task, when is the best time to read the choices?
questions.explanation: Read the choices first: they tell you what to listen for. If they're times, listen for {点|diǎn} and {半|bàn}; if they're places, for {在|zài}, {到|dào} and {门口|mén kǒu}.

questions.stem: Listen. Who is taller?
questions.explanation: A {比|bǐ} B + adjective: A is more so than B. {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{他|tā}{哥哥|gē ge}{高|gāo} — he is taller than his older brother. The person before {比|bǐ} is the one who is "more".

questions.stem: Listen. How many times has the speaker been to Beijing?
questions.explanation: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{北京|Běi jīng} — I've been to Beijing twice. {过|guo} marks the experience and {两|liǎng}{次|cì} (two times) how often. Never would be {没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}.

questions.stem: Listen to the two speakers. Which is true?

audio.text: 你吃过饺子吗？吃过，很好吃。

choices: The second speaker has eaten dumplings and liked them.
The second speaker has never eaten dumplings.
The second speaker is eating dumplings now.
The second speaker doesn't like dumplings.
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ}{吃|chī}{过|guo}{饺子|jiǎo zi}{吗|ma}？ (Have you ever eaten dumplings?) — {吃|chī}{过|guo}，{很|hěn}{好吃|hǎo chī} (Yes, they're delicious). A {过|guo} question is answered with verb + {过|guo}; "never" would be {没|méi}{吃|chī}{过|guo}.

questions.stem: Listen. What is she wearing?

audio.text: 她穿着一件红色的衣服。

questions.explanation: {她|tā}{穿|chuān}{着|zhe}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu} — she's wearing a red top ({衣服|yī fu} with the measure word {件|jiàn}). {着|zhe} marks the state: she has it on. Trousers would be {裤子|kù zi}, with {条|tiáo}.

questions.stem: {他|tā}{汉语|Hàn yǔ}{说|shuō}___ {很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。 Choose the word for the blank (He speaks Chinese very well).
questions.explanation: After a verb, {得|de} links it to how well it's done: {说|shuō}{得|de}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}. {的|de} goes before a noun ({我|wǒ}{的|de}{书|shū}), {地|de} before a verb ({慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{说|shuō}).

questions.stem: {他|tā}{慢|màn}{慢|màn}___ {走|zǒu}{进|jìn}{教室|jiào shì}。 Choose the word for the blank (He walked slowly into the classroom).
questions.explanation: Before a verb, a description takes {地|de}: {慢|màn}{慢|màn}{地|de}{走|zǒu} (walk slowly). {得|de} comes after the verb ({走|zǒu}{得|de}{很|hěn}{慢|màn}), and {的|de} before a noun.

questions.stem: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}___ {中国|Zhōng guó}，{但是|dàn shì}{没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shàng hǎi}。 Choose the word for the blank (I've been to China, but not to Shanghai).
questions.explanation: Experiences take {过|guo} after the verb: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{中国|Zhōng guó} (I've been to China), and its negative is {没|méi} + verb + {过|guo} ({没|méi}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shàng hǎi}). {着|zhe} marks an ongoing state, which doesn't fit a trip.

questions.stem: {门|mén}{开|kāi}___，{请|qǐng}{进|jìn}。 Choose the word for the blank (The door's open, come in).
questions.explanation: {着|zhe} after a verb describes the state something is in: {门|mén}{开|kāi}{着|zhe} (the door is open). {过|guo} would say the door has been opened at some time in the past.

questions.stem: Which sentence is correct?
questions.explanation: In a {比|bǐ} sentence the adjective stands alone or takes {一点儿|yì diǎnr} after it: {他|tā}{比|bǐ}{我|wǒ}{高|gāo}{一点儿|yì diǎnr} (he's a bit taller than me). {很|hěn} and {非常|fēi cháng} can't go inside a {比|bǐ} sentence.

questions.stem: Match each question to its reply.
questions.explanation: {怎么|zěn me} asks how (by taxi), {为什么|wèi shén me} why ({因为|yīn wèi}…), {多少|duō shao}{钱|qián} how much (a price), a {过|guo} question is answered with verb + {过|guo}, and {几|jǐ}{点|diǎn} asks the time. {是|shì}，{我|wǒ}{是|shì} answers only a {是|shì} question.

questions.stem: Which component completes the character for tā (she): ___也?
questions.explanation: {她|tā} (she) is {女|nǚ} (woman) + {也|yě}. With 亻 (person) it's {他|tā} (he), and with 氵 (water) {池|chí} (pool). The component on the left tells you the meaning.

questions.stem: Which component completes the character for nǐ (you): ___ {=尔=}?
questions.explanation: {你|nǐ} is 亻 (the person radical) + {=尔=}. The same 亻 is in {他|tā}, {们|men}, {位|wèi} and {体|tǐ}. 讠 (speech) is in {说|shuō} and {语|yǔ}.

questions.stem: Which character is the zài in the gap? {我们|wǒ men}{明天|míng tiān} ___ {学校|xué xiào}{见|jiàn}。
questions.explanation: {在|zài} (at, in a place): {在|zài}{学校|xué xiào}{见|jiàn} (see you at school). {再|zài} is also zài, but it means "again" ({再见|zài jiàn}); {左|zuǒ} (left) looks like {在|zài}, and {坐|zuò} (to sit) sounds close. Then write it by hand: the exam's writing part asks for characters.

questions.stem: Which character is the wǔ in the gap? {下|xià} ___ {三|sān}{点|diǎn}。 (three in the afternoon)
questions.explanation: {下午|xià wǔ} (afternoon): {午|wǔ} is one of the handwriting characters. Its vertical stroke stops at the top horizontal; in {牛|niú} (cow) it goes through. {五|wǔ} (five) has the same sound, and {年|nián} (year) is {午|wǔ} with more strokes.

choices: in the café on the ground floor
questions.explanation: {在|zài}{一|yī}{楼|lóu}{的|de}{咖啡馆|kā fēi guǎn}{等|děng}{你|nǐ} — waiting in the café on the first floor ({一|yī}{楼|lóu}, the ground floor). They'll buy clothes after the coffee: {喝|hē}{了|le}{咖啡|kā fēi}{再|zài}{去|qù}{买|mǎi}{衣服|yī fu} (have coffee, then go clothes shopping).

questions.stem: {王芳|Wáng Fāng}{虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{还是|hái shi}{跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{了|le}。 Which is true?
choices: Wang Fang stopped because she was tired.
Wang Fang finished the run although she was tired.
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán}……{但是|dàn shì} is "although…": {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi} (although very tired), {但是|dàn shì}{她|tā}{还是|hái shi}{跑|pǎo}{完|wán}{了|le} (she still ran to the end). {跑|pǎo}{完|wán} is a result complement: the running was finished.

questions.stem: Build the sentence in Chinese.
questions.prompt: I've been to Shanghai twice.
questions.explanation: Verb + {过|guo} + the number of times: {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{两|liǎng}{次|cì}{上海|Shàng hǎi} or {我|wǒ}{去|qù}{过|guo}{上海|Shàng hǎi}{两|liǎng}{次|cì} (a place name can come before or after {两|liǎng}{次|cì}). "Two times" is {两|liǎng}{次|cì}, never {二|èr}{次|cì}.

questions.stem: Listen. Which tone is it?
questions.explanation: {写|xiě}, to write: the third tone, low, as in {请|qǐng}{写|xiě}{一下|yí xià}{你|nǐ}{的|de}{姓名|xìng míng}。

questions.stem: Listen. Which tones are the two syllables?
questions.explanation: {虽然|suī rán}, although: a high level first tone, then a rising second tone (1+2), as in {虽然|suī rán}{很|hěn}{累|lèi}，{但是|dàn shì}……

questions.stem: Read: "{小月|Xiǎo yuè}{今年|jīn nián}{十六|shí liù}{岁|suì}，{是|shì}{高中|gāo zhōng}{学生|xué sheng}。{她|tā}{的|de}{爷爷|yé ye}{都|dōu}{七十|qī shí}{岁|suì}{了|le}，{但是|dàn shì}{身体|shēn tǐ}{很|hěn}{好|hǎo}。" How old is Xiaoyue's grandpa?
questions.explanation: {她|tā}{的|de}{爷爷|yé ye}{都|dōu}{七十|qī shí}{岁|suì}{了|le} — her grandpa is already seventy. {十六|shí liù}{岁|suì} (sixteen) is Xiaoyue's age.

questions.stem: Read: "{爷爷|yé ye}{想|xiǎng}{给|gěi}{奶奶|nǎi nai}{买|mǎi}{一|yí}{件|jiàn}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}，{但是|dàn shì}{他|tā}{不|bù}{想|xiǎng}{去|qù}{商场|shāng chǎng}，{因为|yīn wèi}{商场|shāng chǎng}{离|lí}{家|jiā}{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}{了|le}。" Why doesn't Grandpa want to go to the shopping centre?
questions.explanation: {因为|yīn wèi}{商场|shāng chǎng}{离|lí}{家|jiā}{太|tài}{远|yuǎn}{了|le} — because the shopping centre is too far from home. {离|lí} gives the distance from a place: A {离|lí} B {远|yuǎn}.

questions.stem: Xiaoyue shows Grandpa a top online: "{您|nín}{看|kàn}，{这|zhè}{件|jiàn}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}{很|hěn}{漂亮|piào liang}，{比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{便宜|pián yi}，{两百|liǎng bǎi}{块|kuài}。" What does she say about the red top?
choices: {"It's cheaper than the other one": '200 yuan.'}
It's more expensive than the other one.
It's the same price as the other one.
questions.explanation: {比|bǐ}{那|nà}{件|jiàn}{便宜|pián yi}，{两百|liǎng bǎi}{块|kuài} — cheaper than that one, 200 yuan. A {比|bǐ} B + adjective: this top (A) is cheaper than that one (B).

questions.stem: Read: "{他|tā}{觉得|jué de}{自己|zì jǐ}{没|méi}{点|diǎn}{好|hǎo}，{所以|suǒ yǐ}{又|yòu}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{次|cì}，{又|yòu}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{一|yí}{次|cì}……{他|tā}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{十|shí}{次|cì}。……{十|shí}{件|jiàn}{红色|hóng sè}{的|de}{衣服|yī fu}！" Grandpa was buying a top on his phone. Why do ten tops arrive?
choices: Grandpa wanted one for each person.
questions.explanation: Nothing seemed to happen ({手机|shǒu jī}{上|shàng}{什么|shén me}{都|dōu}{没有|méi yǒu}), so Grandpa thought he hadn't tapped properly ({没|méi}{点|diǎn}{好|hǎo}) and tapped again and again: {他|tā}{点|diǎn}{了|le}{十|shí}{次|cì}.

questions.stem: Grandpa has bought red tops online, to give one to Grandma on her birthday, and ten arrive. {奶奶|nǎi nai}{问|wèn}：“{是|shì}{谁|shéi}{买|mǎi}{的|de}？” What does Grandpa answer?
questions.explanation: {是|shì}……{的|de} asks and answers who, where or how for something that has happened: {是|shì}{我|wǒ}{在|zài}{网上|wǎng shàng}{买|mǎi}{的|de} — I bought them online. The question {是|shì}{谁|shéi}{买|mǎi}{的|de}？ asks who.
